 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

 About the Role 
 PhysicsWallah (PW) is looking for a dynamic and business-oriented Branch Head to lead its PW SuperClasses centre in Ahmedabad, catering to students preparing for Chartered Accountancy (CA) and Diploma in Accountancy and Law (DAL) programmes. The Branch Head will be responsible for managing end-to-end branch operations, driving student admissions and revenue growth, leading the counselling and sales teams, and ensuring a seamless student experience. The role requires strong business ownership, operational excellence, and the ability to build and lead a high-performing team. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Business Revenue Growth: Drive student enrolments, revenue generation, and achievement of branch-level business targets. Admissions Sales: Manage the complete admission funnel, including lead generation, counselling, follow-ups, conversions, and enrolments for CA and DAL programmes. Branch Operations: Oversee day-to-day centre operations, infrastructure, resource utilisation, batch coordination, and administrative activities. Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage sales, counselling, and operations teams to achieve business objectives and maintain high productivity. Student Experience: Ensure a positive student experience by addressing queries and escalations, monitoring feedback, and implementing initiatives to improve student satisfaction and retention. Academic Coordination: Coordinate with academic teams and faculty to support batch planning, class schedules, and smooth delivery of CA and DAL programmes. Performance MIS: Monitor leads, admission conversions, revenue, collections, team productivity, and other key business metrics. Prepare periodic reports and implement corrective action plans. Local Market Development: Identify business opportunities, understand competitor activities, and develop strategies to strengthen the centre's presence in Ahmedabad. Financial Management: Monitor branch expenses, optimise operational costs, and ensure adherence to organisational policies and budgets. Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with central business, academic, marketing, finance, and operations teams to ensure effective execution of business plans. 
 
 Required Qualifications Experience 
 Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience in education, EdTech, coaching, or a related industry. Prior experience in branch management, centre operations, sales, admissions, or business development. Proven track record of achieving revenue and enrolment targets. Experience in leading teams and managing end-to-end business operations. Strong understanding of sales funnels, customer acquisition, conversion, and revenue management. Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, and business management tools. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience managing a coaching institute, test-preparation centre, or education business. Exposure to CA coaching, professional education, or commerce-related programmes will be an added advantage. Experience in managing multiple functions, including sales, counselling, operations, and student support. 
 
 Key Competencies

title: Major Accounts Manager- Corporate Sales
description:
Job Description Position: Major Account Manager (MAM) Department: Sales & Business Development
 Function: B2B Sales / Key Account Management
 Reporting To: Regional Sales Manager / Sales Head 
 1. Role Overview The Major Account Manager (MAM) will be responsible for driving business growth through new customer acquisition, strategic account management, and revenue expansion across the assigned territory. The role requires a strong focus on developing new business opportunities, managing and strengthening existing customer relationships, achieving sales targets, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. The incumbent will be expected to independently manage key accounts, identify growth opportunities, coordinate with internal teams, and drive sustainable business performance across the Western region. 
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Sales & Business Development Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities across various industries and customer segments. Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify emerging trends, customer requirements, and potential business opportunities. Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and revenue targets. Develop and deliver effective sales presentations, product demonstrations, proposals, and commercial pitches. Identify opportunities for business expansion through new customer acquisition and competitive conversions. Collaborate with internal teams, including Pre-Sales, Service, Finance, Supply Chain, and other relevant departments, to ensure timely execution of customer requirements and resolution of business issues. Develop and execute strategic sales initiatives to improve market penetration and overall business performance. 
 B. Strategic Account Management Act as the primary point of contact for all assigned key accounts and ensure strong customer engagement. Develop and execute effective account management strategies covering both new business acquisition (hunting) and existing account development (farming). Ensure comprehensive mapping, coverage, and engagement of all allocated accounts, including key decision-makers and stakeholders. Build and maintain long-term business relationships with customers through regular engagement and a customer-centric approach. Identify opportunities for revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, contract renewals, and additional product or service offerings. Analyse account potential based on business size, geographical presence, operational capacity, existing business share, and growth opportunities. Prepare account-wise business development plans to maximise customer potential and increase market share. Proactively address customer concerns and coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution. Ensure timely follow-up and collection of outstanding payments from customers in accordance with agreed credit terms and company policies. Monitor account performance and take corrective actions wherever required to protect and grow business. 
 C. Territory & Market Management Manage and develop the assigned territory across the Western region through regular customer visits and market engagement. Plan and execute customer visits to strengthen relationships, generate business opportunities, and improve account coverage. Maintain a structured travel and customer visit calendar. Share weekly updates on customer visits, business opportunities, market developments, and sales pipeline. Participate in regional exhibitions, trade shows, industry events, and customer engagement programmes. Continuously evaluate territory potential and identify opportunities for improving market penetration and customer reach. 
 D. Sales Reporting & CRM Management Maintain accurate and updated records of leads, opportunities, customer interactions, and sales activities in the company's CRM system. Develop and maintain account-wise action plans and opportunity trackers, ensuring timely updates on completed and pending activities. Prepare and submit weekly and monthly sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and performance updates to the reporting manager. Monitor sales performance against targets and proactively highlight gaps, risks, and opportunities. Share relevant market intelligence, competitor activities, customer feedback, and product improvement suggestions. Maintain regular communication with the reporting manager regarding account developments, critical business issues, support requirements, and opportunities requiring management intervention. Ensure accuracy, discipline, and timeliness in all sales-related reporting and documentation. 
 3. Key Skills & Competencies B2B Sales Expertise: Proven experience in B2B sales, preferably in printing solutions, office automation, IT hardware, or technology-enabled services. Business Development: Ability to identify new business opportunities, develop customer relationships, and convert prospects into profitable business. Account Management: Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage strategic and large accounts. Negotiation & Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, commercial negotiation, and influencing skills. Customer Orientation: Strong customer-first mindset with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver effective solutions. Proactive Approach: Demonstrates initiative, ownership, and the ability to identify and pursue opportunities independently without constant supervision. Team Collaboration: Works effectively with cross-functional teams and actively contributes to a positive, collaborative team environment. Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for business outcomes, commitments, customer deliverables, and personal performance. Continuous Learning: Demonstrates a willingness to continuously upgrade product knowledge, market understanding, and professional capabilities. Analytical & Planning Skills: Ability to analyse account potential, develop business plans, manage sales pipelines, and prepare accurate forecasts. Execution Excellence: Strong follow-up, time management, prioritisation, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 4. Experience & Other Requirements Prior experience in B2B sales, key account management, or business development. Experience in managing large corporate accounts and handling complex sales cycles will be an added advantage. Good understanding of the Western region's business markets and customer segments. Proficiency in MS Office and CRM applications. Willingness and ability to travel extensively across the assigned territory. Ability to work independently in a target-driven and performance-oriented environment. 
 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance in this role will be measured through the following parameters: Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. New customer acquisition and business generated from competitive accounts. Revenue growth and business expansion from existing accounts. Account coverage, stakeholder mapping, and customer engagement. Upselling, cross-selling, and contract renewal performance. Sales pipeline development, conversion ratio, and forecast accuracy. Timely collection of customer payments and outstanding dues. Customer satisfaction, retention, and issue resolution. CRM hygiene, account planning, and reporting discipline. Territory development and overall market penetration. 
 6. Desired Profile The ideal candidate will be a self-driven, commercially oriented sales professional with strong business development and relationship management capabilities. The individual should demonstrate a high degree of ownership, strategic thinking, and execution discipline, with the ability to independently manage a territory, develop key accounts, and consistently deliver business results. The role requires someone who is proactive, customer-focused, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning and professional growth.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Role Summary 
 We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive with strong core SEO skills to grow organic visibility, traffic and qualified leads. While SEO will be the primary focus, the role also contributes across the wider digital marketing mix, including content, social media, paid campaigns, email marketing and analytics. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 • Keyword & competitor research: Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis and search-intent mapping to build and maintain the SEO roadmap. • On-page SEO: Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal linking, images and schema markup. • Technical SEO: Run regular site audits and resolve issues relating to crawlability, indexation, site speed, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps and robots.txt. • Off-page SEO: Plan and execute ethical link-building through guest posts, digital PR, outreach and partnerships; monitor and manage the backlink profile. • SEO content: Brief writers, optimize blogs and landing pages, and refresh existing content to improve rankings. • Local SEO: Manage Google Business Profile and local citations where relevant. • Emerging search: Optimize content for featured snippets and AI-driven search experiences (AI Overviews, answer engines). • Reporting: Track rankings, organic traffic, conversions and visibility; prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with insights and recommendations. 
 Other Digital Marketing 
 • Support Google Ads and paid social (LinkedIn, Meta) campaigns, including setup, keyword/audience selection and performance monitoring. • Plan and schedule social media content and track engagement. • Assist with email marketing campaigns, newsletters and basic marketing automation. • Coordinate website updates and landing pages in the CMS (e.g. WordPress) and recommend CRO improvements. • Set up and maintain tracking with GA4 and Google Tag Manager; build dashboards in Looker Studio. • Work with design, content, sales and web teams to align campaigns with business goals. Quality & Documentation • Follow search engine guidelines and use only ethical, white-hat SEO practices; avoid spammy or manipulative tactics. • Maintain keyword trackers, audit checklists, content calendars and SEO documentation. • Stay updated on search engine algorithm changes and industry trends, and adapt strategy accordingly. • Communicate priorities clearly, meet deadlines and proactively flag risks or opportunities. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications • 1- 3 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in a B2B, IT services or agency environment. • Strong command of on-page, off-page and technical SEO fundamentals and current search engine guidelines. • Proficiency with SEO tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush/Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Moz. • Working knowledge of at least two additional digital marketing areas, such as paid media (Google Ads/paid social), social media, content marketing, email marketing or CRO. • Familiarity with WordPress or similar CMS; basic understanding of HTML/CSS. • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for tracking and reporting. • Ability to analyze data, interpret trends and translate them into clear actions. • Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Preferred / Good to Have 
 • Google Analytics, Google Ads or HubSpot certifications. • Experience with international or multi-location SEO. • Exposure to AI tools for content, research and SEO workflows. • Basic graphic/content tools knowledge (e.g. Canva). Key Performance Indicators 
 • Growth in organic traffic, keyword rankings and organic leads/conversions. • Improvement in technical site health and Core Web Vitals scores. • Quality and quantity of backlinks acquired. • Timely, accurate reporting and campaign execution.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Job Description Marketing Executive, Naveen Tile. 
 Role at glance A full-time, travel-heavy role based in Bangalore: field days setting up Google Business Profiles at our showrooms, office days building backlinks. 
 Job title:Marketing Executive (Local SEO & Google Business Profile) 

 Company: Naveen Tile (Murudeshwar Ceramics Limited) 
 Base location: Corporate Office, M.G. Road, Bangalore Travel:Required: all 25 showroom locations across Karnataka, Hyderabad, Chennai and Karaikal 
 Experience: 1 to 3 years Salary: 2.55 LPA, based on experience. Employment type: Full-time. Languages: Kannada and English. 
 About Naveen Tile: Naveen Tile is the tile brand of Murudeshwar Ceramics Limited, part of the RN Shetty Group of Companies, with over 40 years in the tile business. We make ceramic, vitrified, porcelain, designer and cool roof tiles for homes, offices and commercial projects. Our products are sold through 25 showroom locations: 21 across Karnataka, plus Hyderabad, Chennai and Karaikal. The role You will get every Naveen Tile showroom found on Google Search and Maps. That means travelling to each of our 25 locations to create, verify and fill out its Google Business Profile (GMB), with photos, videos and a steady flow of customer reviews. On office days in Bangalore, you will build quality backlinks and local listings that lift naveentile.com and each showroom in search results. Field responsivities s: Google Business Profile (GMB) On showroom visits, you own each location's Google presence from setup to reviews. GMB setup and verification Visit each showroom to create, claim or verify its Google Business Profile, including on-site video verification. Find and fix duplicate, closed or wrong listings for Naveen Tile showrooms. Make sure the name, address and phone number match the Find Store page exactly. Complete every profile: categories, hours, description, products, services, attributes, website and WhatsApp links. Post regular updates on each profile, such as new collections and offers. Showroom photos and videos Shoot photos and short videos at every visit: storefront and signage, interiors, tile displays, product close-ups and staff. Upload them to each GMB profile and share them with the team for social media and the website. Keep a shared photo library, organized by showroom. Google reviews Train showroom staff to ask happy customers for Google reviews. Set up review QR codes and links at each showroom counter. Reply to reviews and questions on every profile within 48 hours, including on office days. Track review count and rating per showroom, and flag negative reviews to the showroom manager. Office responsibilities: backlinks and local listings. 
 On office days at the Bangalore corporate office, you build links and listings that help naveentile.com and each showroom rank. Build quality backlinks to naveentile.com through guest posts, blogger and publisher outreach, PR mentions, and home decor, interior design and architecture websites. Get links from partners: dealers, builders, architects and project clients. List every showroom on local directories and maps with the same name, address and phone, for example Justdial, IndiaMART, Sulekha, Bing Places and Apple Maps. Use only safe, white-hat methods. No paid link schemes, private blog networks or spam directories. Keep a backlink and listings tracker: site, link, date, status. Send a monthly report covering new backlinks and referring domains, live listings, GMB calls, direction requests and website clicks, and reviews per showroom. 
 Travel Travel is heavy for the first 3–4 months, then drops to occasional visits. Months 1–4: visit all 25 showrooms to set up and verify their GMB profiles, shoot photos and videos, and train staff on reviews. Trips include overnight stays. After setup: visit showrooms as needed, for new openings, re-verification, fresh photos and refresher training. Most of the week is spent in the Bangalore office. Travel, stay and daily expenses are covered as per company policy. The 25 showrooms you will cover, grouped by route: 

 Who we are looking for You have 1–3 years of hands-on local SEO work and are happy to spend long stretches on the road. Must have 1–3 years in digital marketing, with hands-on Google Business Profile and off-page SEO work. Has created and verified GMB listings, including video verification, and handled suspended or duplicate listings. Knows white-hat link building: guest posts, outreach, directories and local citations. Fluent spoken Kannada and English, and clear written English for outreach emails. Willing to travel across Karnataka and to Hyderabad, Chennai and Karaikal, including overnight stays. Can take good photos and short videos on a smartphone. Comfortable with Google Sheets or Excel for trackers and reports. Graduate in any discipline; marketing background preferred. Good to have Hindi, Telugu or Tamil, for the showrooms outside Karnataka. Own two-wheeler with a valid driving license. Experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 and an SEO tool such as Ahrefs, Semrush or Uber suggest. Basic Canva and phone video editing (CapCut, InShot). Experience with a multi-location retail, building materials or home decor brand. Basic WordPress knowledge. 
 What we offer Salary of 2.5–5 LPA, based on experience. Travel, stay and daily expenses covered as per company policy. Full ownership of local search for a brand with over 40 years in tiles and 25 showrooms. Hands-on experience across three states. 
 What success looks like By month 4: all 25 showrooms have a verified, complete GMB profile with fresh photos and videos. By month 4: every showroom has a review QR code and staff who ask customers for reviews. Every month: backlink and listing targets agreed with your manager are met, and the monthly report is on time. Ongoing: more calls, direction requests and website clicks from GMB, and a rising review count per showroom. 
 Interested Candidate can contact and share your updated CV below details. Contact: Bharath Shetty. Contact Number: 8197136530. Mail : hr.blore@naveentile.com bharathakumarshetty@gmail.com

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
ROLE PURPOSE The Digital Marketing Manager is responsible for leading the digital media agenda for Muthoot FinCorp ONE, with a dual mandate of strengthening brand consideration and driving customer acquisition. The role owns digital media strategy, planning, execution and optimisation across paid channels and is responsible for ensuring that media investments deliver against clearly defined marketing and business objectives. The incumbent will manage digital media agencies and partners, recommend deployment of approved budgets across channels and campaigns, and continuously improve media effectiveness based on performance. A key requirement of the role is to connect digital media activity with downstream business outcomes. The role will therefore maintain visibility across the customer funnel from impressions and reach through traffic, leads, applications, conversions and disbursals, working with relevant internal teams to understand and improve performance. The immediate scope is Muthoot FinCorp ONE, with the potential for the role to progressively support the broader Muthoot FinCorp digital media mandate. 
 KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Digital Media Strategy Translate brand and business objectives into integrated digital media strategies. Define the appropriate combination of channels, audiences, formats and campaign objectives. Develop media strategies across Google, Meta, programmatic, online video and other relevant paid digital channels. Balance investments between brand-building and customer-acquisition objectives. Identify emerging digital media opportunities and recommend their application to Muthoot FinCorp ONE. Outcome: A clearly defined digital media strategy that delivers both brand impact and customer acquisition. 
 2. Digital Brand Building Develop paid media strategies for key brand and product campaigns. Build audience strategies designed to deliver effective reach and frequency amongst priority customer segments. Partner with Brand and Content teams to ensure creative ideas are effectively translated into digital media. Drive amplification of key campaigns across relevant digital platforms. Track indicators such as reach, frequency, engagement, video consumption, branded search and consideration. Outcome: Sustained improvement in Muthoot FinCorp ONE's visibility and consideration amongst priority customer audiences. 
 3. Customer Acquisition Plan and manage acquisition campaigns across search, social, display, video, affiliates and other relevant digital channels. Drive traffic, leads, journey initiations and applications for priority Muthoot FinCorp ONE propositions. Continuously optimise campaigns across audiences, creatives, placements, platforms and bidding strategies. Balance acquisition volumes with lead quality, conversion and cost efficiency. Build effective prospecting and conversion campaign structures. Outcome: Scalable and cost-efficient acquisition of customers with demonstrable contribution to business volumes. 
 4. Full-Funnel Media Effectiveness Define appropriate KPIs across each stage of the funnel. Track media-generated customers through downstream business outcomes. Work with Business, Product and Analytics teams to understand lead quality and conversion. Identify significant funnel drop-offs and determine whether interventions are required across media, audience, communication or customer journeys. Use downstream conversion information to improve future media decisions. Build a clear understanding of digital media's contribution to customer acquisition and disbursals. Outcome: Media decisions increasingly optimised against business outcomes rather than platform-level metrics alone. 
 5. Media Planning & Investment Management Develop annual, quarterly and campaign-level digital media plans. Recommend allocation of approved budgets across platforms, campaigns and objectives. Recommend reallocation of spends based on campaign performance and changing business priorities. Monitor utilisation and ensure adherence to approved budgets. Maintain appropriate governance over campaign spends, approvals and reporting. Continuously identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of media investment. Outcome: Disciplined allocation of digital media investment with demonstrable improvements in effectiveness and efficiency. 
 6. Agency & Partner Management Develop clear agency briefs linked to marketing and business objectives. Evaluate media recommendations, audience strategies and campaign plans. Challenge agency recommendations where required and independently assess opportunities for improvement. Ensure campaigns are launched accurately, on time and within approved budgets. Establish structured agency performance reviews. Hold partners accountable for campaign delivery, optimisation, reporting and agreed outcomes. Outcome: High-quality agency output with strong accountability for performance and execution. 
 7. Measurement, Analytics & Optimisation Establish campaign dashboards and regular performance reviews. Monitor metrics including reach, frequency, CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL/CPA, conversion rates and downstream business conversion. Analyse performance across channels, campaigns, audiences, creatives and propositions. Conduct structured experiments across media strategies, audiences, formats and creative executions. Translate campaign data into clear recommendations and actions. Build learnings from completed campaigns into future media planning. Outcome: Continuous improvement in digital media performance supported by robust measurement and experimentation. 
 EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS Experience 58 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, media planning or performance marketing. Demonstrated experience managing paid digital campaigns across major digital platforms. Experience spanning both brand-led digital media and performance/customer-acquisition marketing. Experience managing digital media agencies and evaluating media recommendations independently. Strong understanding of digital media planning, audience strategy, campaign optimisation and measurement. Experience working with customer acquisition funnels and downstream conversion metrics. Exposure to BFSI, fintech, consumer internet, telecom, e-commerce or other high-volume consumer businesses preferred. Education MBA/PGDM or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business or a related discipline preferred. 
 KNOWLEDGE & CAPABILITIES Digital media strategy and planning Paid search and paid social Programmatic and online video Audience planning and segmentation Brand and performance media Media economics and budget allocation Customer acquisition Campaign measurement and optimisation Digital funnel analysis Agency management Experimentation and performance improvement Data interpretation and commercial decision-making Familiarity with attribution and digital analytics platforms is desirable. Deep technical ownership of marketing technology implementation is not a requirement for the role.

title: Head of Digital Performance
description:
Talent Right is recruiting on behalf of an established Australia-based B2B growth agency serving clients across Australia and New Zealand. Due to the confidential nature of the appointment, the employers identity will be shared with suitable shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage. 
 We are seeking a hands-on, commercially minded Head of Digital Performance to lead paid media, SEO, AI search and a team of digital specialists. This is a full-time remote leadership position with meaningful overlap with the Australian business day. 
 This is not a role for someone who only manages task lists, accepts platform reports at face value or delegates technical judgement entirely to specialists. 
 What you will own 
 Commercial digital performance across multiple B2B accounts: lead quality, qualified opportunities, pipeline contribution and acquisition efficiency. Google Ads strategy and technical oversight, including Search, Performance Max, tracking, auction dynamics, search intent and budget allocation. SEO and local search strategy, with the technical confidence to audit work, identify ranking barriers and direct specialists. AI search visibility (AEO/GEO): improve discoverability in search and AI-generated answers using credible content, technical foundations and measurable outcomes. An AI-first delivery model: structured briefs, reusable AI skills/agents, automation and specialist QA that increase capacity without compromising accuracy. Measurement and CRM attribution across GA4, GTM, call tracking and lead-to-revenue reporting. Team performance, coaching, accountability, delivery quality and proactive client recommendations. 
 What makes this role different 
 You will be expected to use AI as an operating advantagenot simply to draft content. We want someone who has personally implemented repeatable AI-assisted workflows, knows where AI fails, builds human review into the process and can demonstrate measurable improvements in speed, quality or cost. 
 You must also be comfortable challenging specialists. If SEO rankings stall, tracking numbers conflict or cheap leads fail to become opportunities, you should know what to investigate, what to ask and what to do next. 
 You should bring 8+ years of digital/performance marketing experience, preferably in a multi-client agency and with substantial B2B lead-generation exposure. Proven direct leadership of specialists, including a real example of improving or managing sustained underperformance. Strong technical Google Ads expertise and credible hands-on SEO knowledgenot only reporting familiarity. Practical AI workflow/agent experience and an informed understanding of AEO/GEO and its measurement limitations. Commercial fluency from traffic and leads through MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, pipeline and revenue. Strong GA4, GTM, Search Console, conversion optimisation and attribution judgement. Excellent English, concise senior-stakeholder communication and dependable Australian-time-zone crossover. 
 What success looks like 
 Client accounts are reviewed proactively and commercial risks are identified early. Specialists are clear on standards, ownership, deadlines and corrective actions. Reporting shows business outcomesnot just clicks, CPL and rankings. AI-assisted workflows reduce repetitive manual work while retaining specialist quality control. Digital delivery becomes more consistent, scalable and commercially effective. 
 Selection process 
 Shortlisted candidates will complete a structured interview, discuss a real AI-enabled workflow they have personally implemented, and undertake a time-boxed, anonymised B2B account review. We assess commercial judgement, technical depth, leadership and practical AI capabilitynot CV keywords alone. 
 Apply confidentially

title: AI Graphic Designer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a highly creative and AI-first Graphic Designer who can combine strong design fundamentals with modern AI-powered creative tools to create visually compelling digital, motion, event and print assets. The ideal candidate should be passionate about new-age design trends, generative AI, animation, visual storytelling and emerging creative technologies. Prior experience working with an IT Services, SaaS, Technology, Digital Transformation or B2B organization will be highly preferred. 
 
 Role Overview 
 Role: AI Graphic Designer Qualification: MBA Experience: 3+ years Location: Noida 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Digital Social Media Design 
 Create high-quality static creatives for LinkedIn, Instagram, websites, email campaigns and other digital platforms. Design social media campaigns, carousels, infographics, banners, thumbnails and promotional creatives. Develop visually engaging content around AI, Cloud, Technology, SaaS and Digital Transformation. Adapt creative concepts across multiple digital formats and platforms. Maintain brand consistency while bringing fresh and modern design ideas. 
 
 AI-Powered Creative Design 
 Use Generative AI for creative ideation, image generation, editing and visual exploration. Create AI-generated visuals and enhance them using professional design tools. Develop effective prompts and workflows for high-quality creative assets. Stay updated with emerging AI design, image and video-generation tools. Identify opportunities to improve creative quality and speed using AI. 
 
 Motion Graphics Animation 
 Create modern animations, motion graphics, animated social posts and short-form videos. Transform static creatives into engaging motion content. Create animated infographics, typography, transitions, promotional videos and event content. Support reels, short videos and digital marketing assets. 
 
 Event Large-Format Design 
 Design event backdrops, exhibition booths, stage branding, standees, posters, banners and signage. Create brochures, certificates, merchandise and other event/corporate collateral. Understand large-format printing and production requirements including dimensions, resolution, bleed, crop marks, CMYK/RGB and print-ready exports. 
 
 Corporate Marketing Collateral 
 Design presentations, pitch decks, case studies, brochures, one-pagers and solution sheets. Support marketing campaigns, sales initiatives, partnerships and corporate events. Convert complex technology concepts into simple, engaging and visually appealing communication. Work closely with Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and Leadership teams. 
 
 Required Skills 
 Strong understanding of graphic design, typography, layout, composition and colour theory. Ability to create modern, premium and technology-focused visual designs. Strong visual storytelling and conceptual thinking. Experience with both digital and print design. Understanding of branding and visual identity systems. Experience in motion graphics and animations. Knowledge of large-format printing and production processes. Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver within deadlines. Strong attention to detail and quality. 
 
 Required Tools 
 Design: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma, Canva Motion Video: Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, Jitter, Rive AI Design Image: Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, ChatGPT, Ideogram, Recraft AI Video - Preferred: Runway, Kling, Google Veo, Luma or similar platforms 
 
 Preferred Background 
 3-6 years of professional graphic design experience. Prior experience with IT Services, SaaS, Technology, Consulting, Digital or B2B organizations is highly preferred. Experience creating content around AI

description:

The candidate must have an exceptionally strong command of the English language , including grammar, vocabulary, sentence construction, comprehension and proofreading. The role requires the ability to simplify concepts and create content that is clear, engaging and appropriate for young learners. Responsibilities Develop educational content for Pre-Primary and Primary grades , including textbooks, workbooks, worksheets, activity books and supplementary learning resources. Write clear, engaging and age-appropriate English content based on defined learning objectives. Develop stories, poems, passages, activities, exercises, questions and assessments for young learners. Ensure high standards of English grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary and sentence structure across all content. Edit, proofread and improve content for language accuracy, clarity, consistency and readability . Simplify complex concepts into child-friendly explanations and activities. Develop content according to curriculum, syllabus and grade-level requirements . Conduct research and fact-check content before submission. Create activity-based, experiential and interactive learning content. Ensure progression of concepts and difficulty levels across grades. Work closely with editors, curriculum experts, designers and illustrators to develop effective learning resources. Provide clear briefs and references for illustrations, layouts and visual elements. Review designed pages/PDFs to ensure content accuracy and correct placement. Incorporate feedback from reviewers and stakeholders within defined timelines. Maintain consistency in terminology, writing style and editorial standards across a series. Ensure content is original, plagiarism-free and academically accurate . English Language Competency The candidate must demonstrate: Excellent written English Strong command of English grammar and syntax Excellent vocabulary and word usage Strong proofreading and editing skills Ability to identify grammatical and contextual errors independently Ability to write naturally for different age groups Strong understanding of sentence construction, punctuation and spelling Ability to simplify language without compromising accuracy Ability to adapt tone and vocabulary according to the learners age Strong comprehension and creative-writing ability Candidates with average English-language proficiency will not be suitable for this role. Pre-Primary Content Skills The candidate should be comfortable developing content related to: Phonics and early literacy Alphabet and vocabulary development Rhymes and stories Pre-writing and writing-readiness activities Picture-based learning Early numeracy and concept-building activities General awareness and environmental concepts Social-emotional and life-skills activities Play-based and activity-based learning Primary Content Skills The candidate should be able to develop: Reading and comprehension passages Grammar and vocabulary exercises Creative-writing activities Stories, poems and informational texts Concept explanations Worksheets and practice exercises MCQs, objective and subjective questions Application-based and competency-based questions Activities, projects and assessments Grade-appropriate learning outcomes Preferred Knowledge Understanding of NEP 2020, NCF and competency-based education Familiarity with CBSE/State Board/NCERT curriculum frameworks Understanding of child development and age-appropriate pedagogy Experience in educational publishing or curriculum development Familiarity with Blooms Taxonomy and learning outcomes Basic understanding of phonics and foundational literacy and numeracy (FLN) Key Skills English Language Proficiency Content Writing Editing Proofreading Grammar Creative Writing Curriculum Development Research Storytelling Worksheet Development Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is excellent with English, creative with content and meticulous about accuracy . The candidate should be able to look at a piece of educational content and independently identify issues related to grammar, language, readability, age appropriateness, learning value and presentation . A strong eye for detail, ownership of work and the ability to deliver high-quality, error-free content within timelines are essential. You will identify prospective customers, initiate meaningful conversations and build a qualified pipeline for the sales team.

Generate qualified sales pipeline through outbound calling, email, LinkedIn and other creative prospecting channels. Conduct high-volume, high-quality outbound calls during US/Canada business hours. A resilient, coachable and metrics-driven approach, with the ability to manage rejection and remain accountable to targets. Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.

Exposure to enterprise sales cycles and account-based prospecting.

Work at the forefront of the evolving LLM and Generative AI ecosystem. Gain direct exposure to North American enterprise sales and sophisticated technology buyers. Work with a collaborative, high-energy team that values ownership, curiosity and initiative over hierarchy.

This is the operational backbone of the finance function. The role spans accounts receivable (invoicing, payment follow-ups, client coordination). You'll work closely with the Finance Manager and coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams to keep financial operations running smoothly. Accuracy is non-negotiable in this role - every invoice, every entry, every reconciliation needs to be correct the first time. 
 What you'll do Accounts receivable Raise tax invoices and proforma invoices for enterprise clients and share them within defined timelines no delays in billing Follow up with clients for payment collection: track outstanding amounts, make follow-up calls, and update payment status on internal systems Book payments received from clients accurately in the accounting system match payments to invoices, flag discrepancies, and reconcile regularly Upload tax invoices on client vendor portals as required many enterprise clients have specific portal-based submission processes Prepare and share balance confirmation statements as per client requests Follow up with clients on TDS receivables track TDS deductions, collect TDS certificates, and ensure they are accounted for correctly 
 Accounts payable Prepare and maintain the expense register track all company expenses with accurate categorisation and documentation Issue Form 16A (TDS certificates) to vendors within prescribed timelines Manage petty cash: process petty cash vouchers, maintain the petty cash register, and ensure regular reconciliation 
 Financial record-keeping & compliance support Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all financial transactions in the accounting system every entry should be audit-ready Prepare supporting schedules and documentation for internal and external audits when required Maintain organised digital and physical records of invoices, receipts, contracts, and compliance documents 
 Internal coordination Coordinate with the Sales and Account Management teams on client invoicing: billing schedules, special terms, credit notes, and invoice corrections Respond to internal queries on invoice status, payment timelines, and vendor account details in a timely and accurate manner

 Days 3160 Handle the full accounts receivable cycle independently: invoice raising, client follow-ups, payment booking, and TDS tracking Take ownership of at least one recurring financial task end-to-end (e.g., weekly receivables follow-up, petty cash reconciliation, or vendor portal submissions) Support the Finance Manager with your first month-end close prepare data, reconcile accounts, and flag any open items

 Good-to-have skills B.Com, M.Com, or equivalent qualification in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance Experience working with enterprise client billing processes, vendor portals, and procurementnteams Familiarity with bank reconciliation processes and month-end closing activities Exposure to statutory compliance workflows: GST return filing, TDS return filing, or audit preparation Experience in a SaaS or technology company where subscription-based billing is the revenue model

title: Executive
description:
Ocean Export Operations
- Execute end-to-end ocean export shipments from booking through documentation, customs clearance, vessel departure, and pre-alert. 
- Coordinate FCL and LCL export shipments in line with customer requirements and agreed SOPs. 
- Coordinate shipment bookings with shipping lines/NVOCCs based on routing, transit time, equipment availability, and customer requirements. 
- Track key shipment milestones including booking confirmation, container planning, empty pickup, stuffing, customs clearance, gate-in, documentation, vessel departure, and pre-alert. 
- Ensure adherence to vessel cut-offs, SI cut-offs, VGM deadlines, port/CFS timelines, and other operational milestones. 
- Monitor vessel schedules, rollovers, blank sailings, port congestion, equipment shortages, and other operational disruptions. 
- Proactively flag potential delays or service issues and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution. 
- Ensure accurate and timely updating of shipment status in the operating system. 
- Execute shipments in accordance with customer-specific SOPs and service requirements. 
Documentation & Compliance
- Prepare and coordinate shipping documentation including Shipping Instructions, Bill of Lading, VGM, invoices, packing lists, certificates, and other required documents. 
- Verify HBL/MBL details and coordinate with customers, shipping lines, and agents for corrections or amendments. 
- Coordinate with Customs Brokers/CHA teams to support timely customs clearance and resolution of documentation issues. 
- Ensure compliance with applicable customs, port, shipping line, regulatory, and company requirements. 
- Maintain accurate shipment records and documentation in line with internal SOPs and audit requirements. 
- Identify documentation discrepancies and ensure timely correction to avoid shipment delays. 
Shipping Line & Vendor Coordination
- Coordinate with shipping lines, NVOCCs, CFSs, ICDs, transporters, customs brokers, and other service providers for smooth shipment execution. 
- Follow up on bookings, equipment availability, container release, gate-in, documentation, vessel schedules, and sailing confirmations. 
- Coordinate resolution of booking failures, equipment shortages, rollovers, vessel delays, and other service issues. 
- Track vendor and shipping line performance and highlight recurring operational issues to the concerned stakeholders. 
- Provide operational inputs on carrier/service performance and capacity constraints where required. 
Customer Service & Stakeholder Coordination
- Provide timely shipment status updates and communicate operational milestones, delays, and exceptions to customers and internal stakeholders. 
- Coordinate closely with Sales and Customer Service teams to ensure customer requirements are delivered as committed. 
- Respond to operational queries and support timely resolution of customer complaints and escalations. 
- Follow customer-specific SOPs and ensure all operational requirements are adhered to. 
- Maintain proactive communication with customers and internal stakeholders to minimize service failures and escalations. 
Shipment Tracking & Exception Management
- Monitor shipments from booking to vessel departure and ensure all critical milestones are completed within defined timelines. 
- Track delays, rollovers, port congestion, equipment shortages, customs issues, documentation gaps, and other shipment exceptions. 
- Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve operational issues and minimize customer impact. 
- Escalate critical or recurring exceptions to the appropriate level in a timely manner. 
- Maintain accurate records of shipment exceptions and ensure timely closure. 
- Support identification of recurring operational issues and implementation of corrective actions. 
Cost & Operational Efficiency

title: Factory Accountant
description:
Qualification CA Inter / CMA Inter or equivalent Strong knowledge of accounting principles and Indian taxation Experience in ERP/accounting software is preferred 1. Job Purpose The Factory Accountant will be responsible for managing the day-to-day accounting and financial activities of the manufacturing unit, ensuring accurate recording of transactions, proper control over factory expenses, inventory accounting, statutory compliance , audit and timely financial reporting. The role will work closely with Production, Stores, Purchase & Sales to ensure effective financial control over factory operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Accounting Maintain accurate books of accounts relating to factory operations. Record purchase, sales, expenses, receipts, payments and journal transactions. Perform monthly account closing activities. Prepare factory-level income and expenditure statements. Ensure proper accounting of capital and revenue expenditure. Review accounting entries and identify errors or unusual transactions. B. Inventory & Stores Accounting Monitor accounting of raw materials, consumables, packing materials, work-in-progress and finished goods. Reconcile physical inventory with book records. Review material receipts, issues, transfers and adjustments. Coordinate with Stores and Production for periodic physical stock verification. Investigate and report stock shortages, excesses and discrepancies. Monitor slow-moving, obsolete and non-moving inventory. Ensure proper accounting of inventory adjustments and write-offs. C. Production & Cost Accounting Monitor production-related costs and expenditure. Analyze material consumption, labor cost and factory overheads. Compare actual production costs with standard/budgeted costs. Analyze production variances and identify significant deviations. Work with Production and Costing teams to improve cost control. Assist in calculation and analysis of manufacturing overheads. Ensure Cost audit is completed on time D. Accounts Payable & Purchase Accounting Verify supplier invoices against purchase orders, GRNs and supporting documents. Ensure correct accounting of purchases, expenses and input taxes. Monitor vendor balances and outstanding payments. Reconcile vendor accounts periodically. Identify duplicate or incorrect invoices. Coordinate with Purchase and Stores regarding invoice discrepancies. E. Accounts Receivable & Sales Accounting Ensure Recording sales transactions accurately. Monitor customer outstanding balances. Ensure Reconcile customer accounts. Coordinate with the sales team regarding overdue payments. Ensure correct accounting of sales returns, discounts, credit notes and debit notes. F. Cash & Banking Monitor cash transactions and petty cash. Verify supporting documents for cash payments. Maintain cash book and perform periodic cash verification. Ensure bank reconciliation statements. Monitor factory bank transactions and identify unreconciled items. G. GST & Statutory Compliance Assist in preparation and filing of GST returns. Ensure proper accounting and reconciliation of: Input Tax Credit Output GST Purchase invoices Sales invoices E-invoices E-way bills Assist in TDS compliance and reconciliation. Maintain records required for statutory audits and tax assessments. Coordinate with corporate finance, tax consultants and auditors. H. Fixed Assets Maintain the fixed asset register. Record additions, disposals and transfers of fixed assets. Ensure proper capitalization of eligible expenditure. Calculate depreciation as per applicable accounting policies. Coordinate with the factory team for periodic physical verification of assets. I. Payroll & Employee-Related Accounting Coordinate with HR/payroll for accounting of factory employee costs. Verify salary-related accounting entries. Monitor accounting of statutory deductions such as PF, ESI, PT and TDS. Assist in reconciliation of employee-related liabilities. J. Budgeting & MIS Assist in preparation of the factory annual budget. Prepare monthly Flash & MIS reports relating to: Production cost Material consumption Factory overheads Inventory Payables Receivables Capital expenditure Budget vs. actual expenditure Provide financial analysis and explanations for significant variances. K. Internal Controls Ensure compliance with company accounting policies and internal controls. Review authorization and supporting documentation for transactions. Identify control weaknesses and recommend corrective measures. Prevent and identify accounting errors, duplicate payments and unauthorized expenditure. Support internal and external audit requirements. L. Audit Support Coordinate with statutory, internal, cost and tax auditors during audits. Provide schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents. Respond to audit queries and ensure timely closure of audit observations. Maintain proper documentation and audit trails. 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The Factory Accountant will be evaluated on: Accuracy and timeliness of factory accounts. Timely monthly closing of accounts. Inventory reconciliation accuracy. Reduction in inventory discrepancies. Accuracy of production cost reporting. Timely GST/TDS and other statutory compliance. Timely completion of bank and ledger reconciliations. Accuracy of MIS and variance reporting. Control over factory expenses. Timely closure of audit observations. Reduction in accounting errors and duplicate transactions. Quality and reliability of financial information provided to management. 4. Required Skills Technical Skills Strong knowledge of accounting principles. Manufacturing / factory accounting experience. Good understanding of inventory accounting. Knowledge of cost accounting principles. Working knowledge of GST and TDS. Good knowledge of MS Excel. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Tally or similar systems. Analytical Skills Ability to analyze production costs and variances. Ability to reconcile large volumes of financial data. Strong attention to detail. Ability to identify accounting discrepancies and control weaknesses. Behavioural Skills Integrity and confidentiality. Strong ownership and accountability. Good communication skills. Ability to coordinate with Production, Stores, Purchase, HR and Finance teams. Ability to work independently in a factory environment. Strong problem-solving skills. 5. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a hands-on finance professional with strong factory accounting experience , capable of independently managing the accounting activities of a manufacturing unit while maintaining effective financial controls. The candidate should be comfortable working closely with Production, Stores, Purchase and Operations , rather than being limited to routine book-keeping activities. Strong experience in inventory reconciliation, manufacturing cost analysis, GST, ERP accounting and monthly MIS will be particularly valuable.

Key Skills: Statutory,Tax audit,Statutory audit,Taxation,Factory,Auditing,Factory accounts,Accounting

 We are looking for Junior Accountants with strong practical knowledge of billing and day-to-day business accounting to join our Product Support team. 
 This is not a traditional accounting/back-office role . 
 You will be trained extensively on our healthcare billing and business-management software and will become a Product Subject Matter Expert (SME) responsible for demonstrating the software to customers, helping them understand workflows, and resolving functional product queries. 
 Our customers include retail pharmacies, pharma distributors, clinics, diagnostic centres, and hospitals.

 What You Will Do: 
 Become an expert in Tapza's billing, inventory, accounting, GST, and reporting workflows. Conduct product demonstrations for prospective customers. Train new customers and their staff on how to use the software. Support customers with functional queries related to billing, purchases, sales, stock, accounts, margins, GST, reports, and reconciliation. Understand customer issues and determine whether they are usage-related, accounting-related, or product/technical issues. Coordinate with the technology team for bugs or technical issues and follow them through to resolution. Assist customers during onboarding and software adoption. Explain reports and calculations clearly to customers. Collect customer feedback and communicate product requirements to the internal product and technology teams. Maintain professional and responsive communication with customers. 
 Accounting Knowledge Required: 
 You should have a practical understanding of: 
 Sales and purchase entries Purchase and sales invoices Debit notes and credit notes Customer and supplier ledgers Receivables and payables Cash and bank transactions Gross profit and margin calculations Discounts and taxes GST basics Stock and inventory accounting Expense entries Reconciliation Financial and business reports 
 What We're Looking For: 
 B.Com / M.Com / relevant accounting qualification. 1–3 years of practical accounting or billing experience preferred. Working knowledge of Tally, Marg, Zoho Books, Busy, or similar accounting/billing software is highly preferred. Comfortable understanding calculations, ledgers, reports, and business transactions. title: Finance & Accounts Staff
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 FINANCE STAFF 
 SNG FREIGHT PVT. LTD. 
 1. Position Information 
 Position: Account and Finance Staff Department: Finance & Accounting Company: SNG FREIGHT PVT. LTD. Reports To: Finance Manager / Management 
 2. Job Purpose 
 To support the company's daily finance and accounting activities by ensuring that all payment, billing, collection, reconciliation, and financial documentation processes are handled accurately, timely, and in accordance with company policies, procedures, and applicable regulations. 
 3. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Accounts Payable & Payment 
 Prepare and process payment requests based on approved company procedures. 
 Review and verify vendor invoices, quotations, purchase orders, receipts, and other supporting documents before payment processing. 
 Ensure that invoices and payment requests have the appropriate approvals and supporting documentation. 
 Process accounts payable transactions accurately and within the agreed payment schedule. 
 Monitor vendor balances and outstanding payables. 
 Coordinate with vendors regarding invoice discrepancies, payment status, and outstanding documentation. 
 Maintain proper records of all payments and supporting documents. 
 B. Accounts Receivable & Customer Billing 
 Prepare and issue invoices to customers based on approved rates, quotations, contracts, and supporting operational documents. 
 Process and maintain accounts receivable records accurately. 
 Monitor customer outstanding balances and payment due dates. 
 Follow up with customers regarding overdue invoices and outstanding payments. 
 Coordinate with the Sales and Operations teams to resolve billing discrepancies and ensure timely invoicing. 
 Maintain updated records of customer receivables and collection status. 
 Assist in preparing regular accounts receivable aging reports. 
 C. Bank & Cash Management 
 Perform daily bank reconciliation and cash reconciliation. 
 Verify bank transactions against accounting records and supporting documents. 
 Monitor daily cash and bank balances. 
 Identify and follow up on any discrepancies between bank statements, cash records, and accounting records. 
 Maintain proper documentation for bank transactions, transfers, deposits, and other financial activities. 
 D. Financial Records & Documentation 
 Maintain and organize financial documents, including invoices, payment requests, receipts, bank documents, vouchers, and other supporting records. 
 Ensure financial documents are properly filed and easily accessible for internal review, audit, and regulatory requirements. 
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records in the company's accounting system. 
 Ensure proper documentation and filing of both payable and receivable transactions. 
 E. Coordination & Communication 
 Coordinate with vendors, customers, and internal departments regarding invoices, payments, collections, and other financial matters. 
 Work closely with the Operations, Sales, and Commercial teams to ensure that financial transactions are properly supported by operational documents. 
 Follow up with internal departments for missing or incomplete documents required for billing or payment processing. 
 Communicate financial discrepancies or issues to the Finance Manager / Management in a timely manner. 
 F. Accounting & Tax Support 
 Assist in routine accounting activities and month-end closing processes as required. 
 Support the preparation of financial reports and financial analysis. 
 Assist in preparing documents and information required for tax reporting and compliance. 
 Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, tax consultants, or other appointed parties when required. 
 Ensure financial records and transactions are properly maintained to support tax and accounting compliance. 
 G. Internal Control & Compliance 
 Ensure all financial transactions are accurate, properly documented, authorized, and recorded. 
 Follow company finance policies, procedures, approval limits, and internal controls. 
 Verify that payments and financial transactions are supported by valid and complete documentation. 
 Maintain confidentiality of company financial information and records. 
 Report any unusual transactions, discrepancies, or potential financial risks to the Finance Manager / Management. 
 4. Reporting & Monitoring 
 The Finance Staff may be required to prepare or assist in preparing: 
 Accounts Payable outstanding reports. 
 Accounts Receivable aging reports. 
 Customer outstanding and collection reports. 
 Vendor outstanding reports. 
 Daily bank and cash reconciliation reports. 
 Payment status reports. 
 Cash flow monitoring reports. 
 Monthly finance and accounting reports. 
 Other financial reports as requested by Management. 
 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Performance will be evaluated based on, among others: 
 Accuracy and timeliness of payment processing. 
 Accuracy of customer billing and invoicing. 
 Timely follow-up and collection of outstanding receivables. 
 Accuracy of bank and cash reconciliation. 
 Completeness and proper filing of financial documents. 
 Compliance with company finance policies and procedures. 
 Timely submission of required financial reports. 
 Ability to identify and resolve financial discrepancies promptly. 
 Proper coordination with vendors, customers, and internal departments. 
 6. Qualifications & Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. 
 Minimum 02 years of relevant experience in Finance/Accounting; experience in freight forwarding, logistics, shipping, or NVOCC companies is preferred. 
 Good understanding of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, invoicing, payment processing, and bank reconciliation. 
 Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting software. 
 Good numerical and analytical skills. 
 Detail-oriented, organized, and able to work with deadlines. 
 Good communication and coordination skills. 
 Able to maintain confidentiality of financial and company information. 
 Knowledge of Indian accounting and tax requirements is an advantage. 
 7. General Responsibilities 
 Perform other finance and accounting-related duties as assigned by the Finance Manager or Management. 
 Provide support to other departments when required for finance-related matters. 
 Maintain professional relationships with customers, vendors, banks, auditors, and other business partners. 
 Ensure all assigned responsibilities are completed accurately and within the required timeline

title: Senior Manager, Fund Accounting
description:
Overview The Senior Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery of private equity fund accounting and fund administration services across multiple client portfolios. The role provides leadership across NAV processing, investor reporting, capital calls, distributions, management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, and other fund operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and high-quality service delivery. Acting as a senior client contact, the Senior Manager manages relationships with clients, auditors, banks, custodians, brokers, and internal stakeholders while ensuring compliance with fund governing documents, regulatory obligations, and service level commitments. The role also drives process improvements, technology initiatives, risk management, and team development to support operational excellence and business growth. 
 Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities Strategic Focus Provide strategic leadership and oversight of private equity fund accounting and fund administration services, ensuring alignment with business objectives, client expectations, and operational priorities. Serve as a senior relationship lead for key clients, auditors, custodians, banks, brokers, and other strategic stakeholders, fostering long-term partnerships and service excellence. Drive operational excellence across NAV production, investor servicing, custody operations, financial reporting, and fund administration activities to ensure consistent, high-quality client outcomes. Oversee complex fund structures, transactions, and reporting requirements, including management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, waterfall models, capital calls, and distributions. Champion operational transformation through process optimization, technology enablement, automation, and scalable service delivery models. Provide strategic oversight of compliance with fund governing documents, regulatory obligations, and internal control frameworks across client portfolios. Contribute to business growth, strategic initiatives, organizational development, and continuous enhancement of the operating model to support long-term success. Direct resource planning, capacity management, and organizational alignment to support efficient service delivery, business growth, and evolving client requirements. Lead and develop managers, team leaders, and fund accounting teams to drive high performance, service excellence, and achievement of operational and client delivery objectives. Serve as a senior relationship lead for key clients and strategic stakeholders across the broader client portfolio. Operational Management Provide oversight of end-to-end private equity fund accounting and fund administration services, ensuring the accurate, timely, and consistent delivery of client commitments across multiple portfolios. Oversee NAV production, investor allocations, capital calls, distributions, fund expense payments, custody activities, and related fund operations to ensure quality and operational effectiveness. Lead operational execution through effective resource planning, workload management, capacity optimization, and performance oversight across teams. Ensure the consistent achievement of service level agreements (SLAs), client deadlines, and quality standards across all client engagements. Review and approve key fund accounting deliverables, including management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, waterfall models, and other complex fund accounting outputs. Direct audit, financial statement, and regulatory reporting activities to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely completion. Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and operational efficiency initiatives to enhance scalability, consistency, and service quality. Provide strategic oversight of operational enhancement initiatives to improve service delivery and operating effectiveness. Provide leadership and oversight for relationships with auditors, banks, custodians, brokers, administrators, and internal stakeholders to support seamless service delivery. Ensure adherence to fund governing documents, regulatory obligations, and internal control frameworks across all operational activities. Monitor operational performance, service quality, and client outcomes to ensure achievement of business and client objectives. Drive consistency, standardization, and best practices across teams and client portfolios. Oversee the resolution of client issues, operational challenges, and escalations, ensuring effective outcomes and a high standard of client service. Support business growth through scalable operating models, operational excellence, and strategic service delivery initiatives. People Leadership Lead, coach, and develop managers, team leaders, and fund accounting professionals, fostering a high-performance, client-focused culture and strong leadership capability across the function. Provide ongoing mentorship, guidance, and development opportunities to strengthen expertise in fund accounting, NAV production, private equity operations, and client service delivery. Drive performance management through objective setting, regular feedback, performance reviews, and career development planning to support individual and organizational success. Oversee workforce planning, resource allocation, and capacity management to optimize operational effectiveness and ensure successful delivery of client commitments. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and operational excellence that supports high-quality service delivery and sustainable business performance. Identify high-potential talent, support succession planning initiatives, and develop future leaders to strengthen organizational capability. Champion cross-training, knowledge sharing, and capability development to enhance team resilience, scalability, and business continuity. Drive employee engagement, continuous learning, innovation, and a culture of continuous improvement across teams. Lead organizational talent development and leadership succession initiatives across multiple teams and functions. Serve as a senior escalation point for complex operational, client, and people-related matters, providing leadership, direction, and effective resolution. Governance Risk Provide strategic oversight to ensure all fund accounting and fund administration activities comply with fund governing documents, regulatory requirements, accounting standards, and internal policies across client portfolios. Maintain a robust control environment through the review and approval of NAVs, investor allocations, capital activity, management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, and fund expense payments. Oversee compliance frameworks in partnership with internal compliance teams and external service providers, ensuring effective adherence to regulatory obligations and due diligence requirements. Review and approve financial reports, regulatory filings, audit deliverables, and other key client outputs to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance. Ensure adherence to governance frameworks, approval authorities, and organizational control standards across all client engagements and operational activities. Monitor, assess, and mitigate operational, financial, regulatory, and service delivery risks through effective governance, controls, and risk management practices. Serve as a senior escalation point for complex operational, client, risk, and compliance matters, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate stakeholder engagement. Lead internal and external audit engagements, ensuring the effective management, remediation, and closure of audit findings and control recommendations. Establish, maintain, and enhance documented procedures, control frameworks, and operating standards to support consistency, transparency, scalability, and business continuity. Champion a culture of accountability, compliance, risk awareness, and continuous improvement across teams and client portfolios. The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs. 
 Experience Personal Attributes Experience 10+ years of experience in fund administration, fund accounting, or alternative investment operations. Proven experience managing and developing teams in a client-service environment. Extensive knowledge of private equity fund structures, investor servicing, and fund administration processes. Strong experience overseeing NAV production, investor allocations, capital calls, distributions, and fund expense processing. Advanced understanding of management fee, carried interest, and waterfall calculations. Experience interpreting and applying Limited Partnership Agreements (LPAs) and other fund governing documents. Demonstrated experience working with auditors, custodians, brokers, banks, and other third-party service providers. Experience supporting audits, financial statement preparation, and regulatory reporting requirements. Strong background in operational controls, risk management, and compliance requirements. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with fund accounting platforms; Investran experience is considered an asset. Proven track record of driving process improvements, system enhancements, and operational efficiencies. Personal Attributes Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop high-performing teams. Client-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service and building trusted relationships. Strategic thinker with the ability to balance operational priorities and long-term business objectives. Highly organized with strong time management and prioritization skills in a deadline-driven environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail and accuracy. Effective decision-maker capable of managing complex issues and competing priorities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. Collaborative team player who fosters positive working relationships across functions and with external partners. Proactive and results-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset. Adaptable and resilient, able to navigate change and lead through evolving business needs. Strong sense of accountability, integrity, and professional judgment. Risk-aware and controls-focused, with a commitment to governance, compliance, and operational excellence. Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive client and fund information. Innovative mindset with a willingness to challenge existing processes and drive operational efficiencies.

 The FNZ Global Group is expanding into other regulated environments around the world. This role will work closely with the Head of Finance to prepare for the growth FNZ Securities is experiencing. Previous experience in a regulatory reporting environment, preferably in the finance industry. Alternatively, solid financial reporting experience across financial services or regulatory reporting project experience within a Big 4 professional services firm. Execution, clearing and settlement knowledge on ASX/NZX or a similar exchange. Strong forecasting and modelling skills , alongwith understanding of Financial control . Strong numeracy skills and familiarity with spreadsheets, analytical tools and reporting tools. Microsoft Navision or AnaPlan, QLIK and Dynamics 365 experience would be advantageous. A good working knowledge of ASX/NZX participant rules would be advantageous. The ability to think strategically and deal with complex challenges in a fluid environment. Specific Role Responsibilities This role has overall responsibility for financial planning, reporting and regulatory compliance for the regulated entity, including: Forecast modelling and reporting to the Board on Liquidity and Core Capital requirements, including possible stress scenarios and impacts on the future P&L and Balance Sheet. Manage budgeting and regular forecasting for the FNZ Securities business. Support Financial Control Team during month end and audit Daily Capital Adequacy and Liquidity reporting and projections in accordance with ASX Rules. Preparation of ASX monthly, quarterly and ad-hoc returns. Maintenance of regulatory reporting policies, procedures and governance frameworks, ensuring adherence to regulatory changes. Continuous improvement of procedures, processes and internal controls. Support new business modelling from a Liquidity and Core Capital requirement perspective. Compile Financial Risk Management reporting. About FNZ FNZ is a global FinTech firm, transforming the way financial institutions serve their wealth management customers. We partner with banks, insurers and asset managers to help people achieve their financial goals through our unique combination of technology leadership, innovation and asset servicing. 
 Our services enable our clients to provide best-in-class wealth management solutions to financial advisers, end-investors and the workplace. We pride ourselves on creating solutions that are flexible, transparent and scalable, reflecting the latest market, demographic and regulatory trends worldwide. 
 FNZ has experienced exceptional growth in the past decade, both in terms of assets under administration and through the substantial expansion of our international footprint. 
 Today, we are responsible for over 1.5 trillion in assets under administration, held by around seven million customers of some of the world's largest financial institutions, including Standard Life Aberdeen, Barclays, Lloyds Banking Group, Aviva, Quilter, HSBC, Santander, Vanguard, Generali, Zurich, UOB, UBS, National Australia Bank and BNZ. 
 In total, we partner with over 650 financial institutions globally and employ over 7,000 people around the world. 
 The company is owned by a combination of CDPQ-Generation, Tamasek and Generation IM along with FNZ employee shareholders. Across the globe, we re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve.
