Position details Risk Reporting for Sales & Trading is a team within the Risk Management Division at MUFG, responsible for delivering risk reports across market risk and counterparty credit risk to key stakeholders on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis. Timely delivery of risk reports to key stakeholders across the first and second lines of defense, as well as senior management, is critical for the management and monitoring of exposures against risk appetite and associated limits. The successful candidate will w ork closely with Risk Managers, Technology, Data Officers and other Risk Reporting team members located across regions to execute risk reporting processes including delivery & enhancement of existing reports, as well as development of new reports. Risk reports convey information at various dimensions and levels of granularity including by booking location. Booking locations are in various regions including the Americas, EMEA, APAC (ex-Japan), and Japan. The Risk Reporting teams are currently organized by region as timely delivery of reports is booking location dependent. This role requires the candidate to work hours which are consistent with the New York time zone. A goal for the Risk Reporting team is to standardize the various regional risk reporting processes into a more uniform global process. This includes process-timing optimization which may result in more flexible time zone coverage ability over time. Roles and Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for market and counterparty credit risk reporting across MUFG s banking and securities businesses You will: Prepare and deliver daily/weekly/monthly market and counterparty credit risk reports Migrate existing and develop new reports using PowerBI Support risk managers through report analysis and enhancement Update policy and procedures relating to market and counterparty credit risk reporting and data processes Lead the preparation of ad-hoc management reports Support the execution of strategic initiatives in collaboration with key stakeholders, including development of new reports, as well as enhancement of existing reports Job Requirements: Required 2-5 years of experience in a banking, financial services, or other regulated financial institution environment, including risk reporting experience for either market risk or counterparty credit risk Basic knowledge of financial markets and products including derivatives Strong ability to analyze and interpret data Strong quantitative and analytical skills, proficient with Excel and VBA Detailed technical knowledge of Power BI and other data/reporting tools Desirable Understanding of market and counterparty risk exposure measures such as VaR, PFE, Stress Testing Detailed technical knowledge of RDBMS (SQL Server or Oracle) and database design methodologies Knowledge of additional reporting tools, such as Tableau Knowledge of advanced programming languages (Python ,C#, C++) Education / Qualifications : Bachelor s degree preferably in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Management or a technical or quantitative discipline Personal Requirements Excellent communication skills, with ability to influence diverse stakeholders Collaborative mindset with ability to work in partnership with other stakeholders; good team player with professional attitude Highly motivated and innovative, able to work on own initiative. Strong writing skills with the ability to synthesize complex concepts and translate into easy-to-understand language, and effectively present in text or slide format Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task in a complex environment with changing priorities Excellent accuracy and attention to detail with an analytical mind-set Good time management and ability to prioritize Ability to manage large workloads and tight deadlines, balancing urgent tasks and longer-term projects Strong decision-making skills, the ability to demonstrate sound judgement Strong problem-solving skills Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. Support periodic and rolling forecast processes by updating models, analyzing trends, and validating assumptions. Maintain and enhance revenue, backlog, and headcount forecasting models. Experience within a Big 4 accounting firm strongly preferred.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling techniques. Experience working with ERP systems, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, and large datasets. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence business partners. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment. Experience in a private equity-backed company preferred. Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity. Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

title: Manager - Financial Planning and Ananlysis
description:
Job Title: Manager - Financial Planning and Analysis Location: Noida Job Summary As Finance Manager, you will serve as a strategic business partner to senior leadership, driving financial planning, commercial decision support, and business performance across Sales, Publishing, Editorial, and corporate functions. The role combines FPA, commercial finance, business partnering, and financial analysis, requiring strong financial acumen, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to translate complex financial insights into actionable business outcomes. This is a high-visibility role offering the opportunity to influence growth strategy, evaluate new products and business initiatives, and lead finance transformation efforts while partnering closely with the CFO, Managing Director, and cross-functional leaders to drive profitability and sustainable business growth. Key Responsibilities Strategic Business Finance Lead the annual and quarterly planning processes, working closely with functional and business leaders, demonstrating strong stakeholder management, strategic mindset, and effective communication skills. Partner with functional heads to understand the key business drivers behind financial performance, leveraging business insights, consulting skills, and financial acumen. Analyse historical performance and develop forward-looking insights to support management decisions, utilizing data analytics, quantitative skills, and a strategic mindset. Own monthly financial reviews and provide insightful analysis of actuals vs. plan, trends, risks, and opportunities through strong financial acumen, business insights, and data analytics capabilities. Prepare high-quality financial analysis and management information for the CFO, MD, and senior leadership team, communicating complex financial matters effectively through strong financial acumen, communication skills, and stakeholder management. Support strategic and ad hoc business analysis as required, applying business insights, financial modelling, valuation methodologies, and a global perspective where relevant. Commercial Finance Revenue Planning Lead the planning process for annual and quarterly revenue/sales plans in partnership with the National Sales Head, CFO, and MD, balancing stakeholder expectations while applying financial modelling, strategic mindset, and financial acumen. Understand sales trends, market dynamics, product performance, and commercial drivers through strong business insights, data analytics, and a global perspective. Provide financial insights to help leadership identify growth opportunities and emerging risks, utilizing financial acumen, strategic thinking, and consulting skills. Analyse profitability and margins across products, customers, and business segments using financial modelling, data analytics, and quantitative skills. Support management in making data-driven commercial decisions through robust financial analysis, business insights, consulting skills, and effective stakeholder engagement. Finance Partner to the Publishing Business This is where the role gets particularly interesting. Work closely with the Publishing and Editorial teams to: Lead the annual planning process for Publishing Plans and Editorial Budgets, applying financial acumen, stakeholder management, and a strategic mindset. Evaluate the financial viability of new products and publishing initiatives using financial modelling, valuation methodologies, and strong business insights. Drive feasibility analysis across products, verticals, and business opportunities through quantitative analysis, financial modelling, and strategic thinking. Analyse production economics, costs, and margins leveraging financial acumen, data analytics, and business insights. Own Gross Margin analysis, including identifying and explaining key drivers and variances through strong quantitative skills, financial analysis, and effective communication. Support decisions around product investments, pricing, volumes, and profitability using financial modelling, valuation methodologies, and a strategic mindset. Act as the finance partner who connects creative/publishing decisions with commercial outcomes through strong consulting skills, stakeholder management, business insights, and effective communication. Author Content Economics Act as the Finance SPOC for the Author Engagement Programme, building trusted relationships through strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Manage financial aspects relating to author royalties and contracts, applying financial acumen, quantitative skills, and sound commercial judgement. Analyse royalty structures and their impact on product economics and margins through data analytics, financial modelling, and business insights. Work with relevant stakeholders to ensure commercial and financial considerations are incorporated into author/content decisions, leveraging consulting skills, stakeholder management, and effective communication. Process Excellence Finance Transformation Identify opportunities to make commercial finance processes simpler, faster, and more effective through business insights, data analytics, and a continuous improvement mindset. Develop and implement robust finance processes across business functions, balancing stakeholder requirements while demonstrating strong consulting skills and stakeholder management. Drive standardisation and consistency in financial processes and reporting through strong financial acumen, communication skills, and process discipline. Develop a strong understanding of financial reporting systems and data architecture, leveraging data analytics, quantitative skills, and a global perspective on best practices. Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial information, including cross-charges and recharges, through strong financial acumen, attention to detail, and analytical rigor. Look for opportunities to improve reporting, analytics, and decision-support capabilities using data analytics, business insights, and financial modelling techniques. Business Partnering Stakeholder Management Become the Finance face and SPOC for business and functional leaders, demonstrating exceptional stakeholder management, consulting skills, and communication effectiveness. Build strong relationships across Finance, Sales, Publishing, Editorial, and other functions by effectively balancing stakeholder needs and fostering collaboration. Be comfortable working across different levels of the organisation, including senior management, demonstrating strong communication skills, business partnering capability, and a global perspective. Challenge constructively, influence decisions, and bring a commercial finance perspective to business discussions through strong consulting skills, strategic mindset, financial acumen, and business insights.

title: Operations Manager
company: E.SUN Commercial Bank, Ltd., Mumbai Branch
description:
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Operations Manager to oversee the daily banking operations of our Mumbai branch. The role will focus on transaction processing and authorization, trade finance, foreign remittances, credit administration, treasury settlements, operational risk management, and regulatory compliance. The Operations Manager will play a key role in maintaining operational accuracy, strengthening internal controls, ensuring compliance with applicable Indian banking regulations, and supporting the Chief Operating Officer (COO) in managing branch operations. The ideal candidate should have 10-15 years of banking experience, preferably with a foreign bank operating in India, and strong hands-on expertise in trade finance and foreign remittance operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Banking Operations Management Oversee daily banking operations and ensure timely, accurate, and efficient processing of transactions. Supervise operational activities covering account opening, remittances, trade finance, treasury settlements, credit administration, and related back-office functions. Review and authorize transactions under the maker-checker control framework, ensuring accuracy, completeness, proper approvals, and compliance with internal policies. Monitor daily reconciliations, suspense accounts, outstanding entries, and unresolved transaction exceptions. Ensure smooth coordination between branch operations, relationship managers, finance, compliance, treasury, and technology teams. Monitor operational performance and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and service quality. 2. Trade Finance and Foreign Remittances Supervise trade finance transactions and ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and international trade practices. Review trade finance documentation and transactions involving letters of credit, guarantees, and other trade-related banking products, as applicable. Apply relevant international trade rules, including Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits (UCP). Oversee domestic and international remittance transactions and ensure accurate and timely processing. Ensure appropriate processing and controls for SWIFT payments and domestic payment systems, including NEFT and RTGS. Coordinate with relevant internal teams and correspondent banks to resolve payment discrepancies, delays, and transaction exceptions. 3. Credit Administration and Treasury Settlement Supervise credit administration activities, including documentation review, disbursement-related controls, loan servicing, and post-disbursement administration. Support the administration of bilateral and syndicated loans, ensuring compliance with approved terms and documentation requirements. Review treasury settlement activities and ensure timely processing, reconciliation, and resolution of discrepancies. Monitor settlement risks, outstanding transactions, and operational exceptions. Coordinate with credit, treasury, finance, and relationship management teams to ensure smooth transaction execution. 4. Regulatory Compliance and Operational Risk Management Ensure adherence to applicable Indian banking regulations, RBI guidelines, internal policies, and operating procedures. Support the implementation and monitoring of the bank's operational risk management framework and internal controls. Ensure compliance with Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), customer due diligence, and transaction monitoring requirements. Conduct periodic account and transaction reviews in coordination with relevant compliance teams. Identify operational risks, irregularities, control weaknesses, and potential compliance breaches, and escalate them promptly. Ensure appropriate documentation, approvals, record retention, and audit trails for banking transactions. 5. Process Control, Reconciliation and Quality Assurance Perform independent transaction reviews and quality checks across operational processes. Ensure all transactions are supported by appropriate documentation and authorization. Monitor daily reconciliations, suspense accounts, pending entries, and unresolved exceptions until closure. Review operational performance indicators and implement corrective actions where required. Identify opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual errors, and strengthen operational controls. Support internal and external audits by providing documentation, explanations, and remediation updates. 6. Banking Systems and Process Improvement Coordinate with IT and technology teams to ensure banking systems effectively support operational requirements. Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT), system testing, upgrades, and process enhancement initiatives. Ensure accurate and consistent use of banking systems for transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation, and reporting. Support the implementation of new operational procedures, system enhancements, and internal control measures. 7. Team Management and Stakeholder Coordination Supervise and guide junior operations staff in daily transaction processing and control activities. Provide on-the-job training and guidance on banking procedures, transaction controls, compliance requirements, and operational systems. Coordinate with lending, compliance, treasury, finance, relationship management, and technology teams. Support communication with Head Office on operational matters, reporting requirements, and process updates. Assist the COO with operational reporting, regulatory inquiries, branch-level initiatives, and special projects. 
 Required Qualifications and Experience 10-15 years of relevant banking operations experience. Experience working with a foreign bank operating in India is highly desirable. Strong understanding of Indian banking regulations applicable to foreign banks and Indian branch operations. Proven expertise in trade finance and foreign remittance operations. Hands-on understanding of account opening, KYC, domestic and international payments, treasury settlements, and credit administration. Knowledge of bilateral and syndicated loan administration. Experience in transaction processing, maker-checker controls, reconciliations, operational risk management, and back-office operations. Strong understanding of domestic payment systems, including NEFT and RTGS, and international payment messaging and remittances through SWIFT. 
 Preferred Certifications and Additional Skills Trade finance certifications such as CDCS (Certified Documentary Credit Specialist) or CSDG (Certificate for Specialists in Demand Guarantees) will be an advantage. Knowledge of UCP 600 and other relevant international trade finance rules and practices. Familiarity with banking systems, transaction processing platforms, and operational reporting tools. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is essential. Mandarin proficiency, both written and spoken, will be an added advantage, particularly for coordination with Head Office. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet strict deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a control-oriented environment.

Key Skills: Transaction processing,Banking Operation,Credit,Processing,Aml,Fund transfer,Treasury,Administration

You will not only manage branch staff and resolve customer grievances with empathy and speed but also step out into the market for offline agent marketing and cash collections. If you are a proactive problem solver with a flair for business growth and competitive intelligence, we invite you to lead our branch to new heights. 
 Job Responsibilities Day-to-Day Operations & Asset Management: Oversee daily branch functioning for both passenger travels and cargo services, ensuring seamless booking workflows, counter management, and proper upkeep of branch assets. Sales Target Achievement: Take complete ownership of branch-level revenue and performance targets for both travels (ticket bookings/charters) and cargo shipments. Customer Grievance & Query Resolution: Serve as the primary escalation point at the branch to handle, resolve, and close all customer queries, complaints, and disputes promptly and professionally. Field Marketing & Cash Collection: Regularly step into the field (weekly/fortnightly) for offline agent marketing, relationship building, and timely cash collections/reconciliation. title: Assistant Manager
description:
Ocean Export Operations
- Manage end-to-end ocean export operations from shipment booking through documentation, customs clearance, vessel departure, and final pre-alert. 
- Oversee execution of FCL and LCL export shipments in accordance with customer requirements and agreed SOPs. 
- Ensure timely booking of shipments with shipping lines/NVOCCs based on customer requirements, routing, transit time, equipment availability, and commercial commitments. 
- Monitor shipment milestones including booking confirmation, container planning, empty pickup, stuffing, customs clearance, gate-in, documentation, vessel departure, and pre-alert. 
- Ensure adherence to vessel cut-offs, SI cut-offs, VGM deadlines, port/CFS timelines, and other operational milestones. 
- Monitor vessel schedules, rollovers, blank sailings, port congestion, equipment shortages, and other operational disruptions. 
- Proactively identify operational risks and take corrective actions to minimize shipment delays and service failures. 
- Ensure timely and accurate updating of shipment status in the operating system. 
- Ensure execution of shipments in line with customer-specific SOPs and service requirements. 
Documentation & Compliance
- Ensure timely and accurate preparation and processing of shipping documentation including Shipping Instructions, Bill of Lading, VGM, invoices, packing lists, certificates, and other required documents. 
- Ensure accuracy of HBL/MBL details and coordinate with shipping lines, agents, and customers for documentation amendments. 
- Ensure compliance with applicable customs, port, shipping line, regulatory, and company requirements. 
- Coordinate with Customs Brokers/CHA teams for timely customs clearance and resolution of documentation issues. 
- Ensure adherence to export regulations, internal controls, and operational SOPs. 
- Monitor documentation discrepancies and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. 
- Maintain proper operational records and documentation for audit and compliance requirements. 
Shipping Line & Vendor Management
- Manage relationships and operational coordination with shipping lines, NVOCCs, CFSs, ICDs, transporters, customs brokers, and other service providers. 
- Coordinate with shipping lines for bookings, equipment availability, container release, gate-in, documentation, vessel schedules, and sailing confirmation. 
- Monitor shipping line and vendor performance against agreed service levels. 
- Escalate and resolve issues related to equipment shortages, booking failures, rollovers, vessel delays, documentation, and cargo movement. 
- Provide inputs to Procurement/Pricing teams regarding carrier performance, service issues, capacity constraints, and vendor requirements. 
- Support evaluation of vendors and service providers based on cost, service quality, reliability, and operational performance. 
Customer Service & Stakeholder Management
- Ensure timely communication of shipment status, operational milestones, delays, and exceptions to customers and internal stakeholders. 
- Work closely with Sales and Customer Service teams to ensure customer requirements and commitments are effectively delivered. 
- Handle operational escalations and ensure timely resolution of customer complaints. 
- Participate in customer meetings and operational reviews as required. 
- Develop strong relationships with key customers and understand their operational requirements and expectations. 
- Ensure customer-specific SOPs are implemented and periodically reviewed.

title: D365 Finance & Operations Functional Consultant
description:
D365 Finance & Operations Functional Consultant Role purpose: Provide hands-on D365 Finance & Operations functional support and delivery capability, helping the D365 Functional Lead maintain a stable, controlled and continuously improving global finance platform. 
 1. Role Overview Field 
 Detail Role Title 
 D365 Finance & Operations Functional Consultant Employment Type 
 Permanent, full-time employee of FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited Reports To 
 Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations Team / Pillar 
 FNZ Finance Systems - D365 Finance & Operations Location 
 India - Gurugram Working Pattern 
 India-based role with regular UK/EU hours overlap for global collaboration Travel 
 Occasional domestic or international travel may be required 
 2. Purpose and Context 
 FNZ has deployed Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations as a core global finance platform. Following global go-live, the Finance Systems team is strengthening permanent in-house capability to stabilise the platform, support Finance operations, deliver controlled improvements and prepare for future modules and entity deployments. This is a hands-on functional role reporting to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations. The role holder will configure and support D365, investigate issues, translate Finance requirements into workable solutions, produce documentation and test evidence, and contribute to controlled releases and continuous improvement. The position requires practical D365 Finance experience. It is not a coordination-only or general business analyst role. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly in the application, partnering with Finance users and technical teams, and taking assigned work through to a documented and supportable outcome. 
 3. Key Responsibilities 
 D365 Functional Support and Configuration Provide hands-on functional support across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management, Project Accounting and Financial Reporting. Configure approved changes in D365 under the direction and design authority of the D365 Functional Lead. Analyse business requirements, current processes and system behaviour; document solution options, functional requirements and acceptance criteria. Maintain accurate configuration, process and support documentation so that knowledge is retained within FNZ. Incident, Close and Operational Support Investigate functional incidents and service requests, reproduce issues, identify root causes and coordinate resolution with Finance users, technical teams and vendors. Support month-end and year-end close activities, reconciliations and business-critical finance processing, including agreed out-of-hours support where required. Distinguish defects, data issues, training needs and enhancement requests, ensuring each is progressed through the appropriate support or change process. Contribute to the upkeep of known-error records, support procedures, knowledge articles and recurring-issue analysis. Change, Testing and Release Delivery Prepare functional specifications, process flows, test scenarios, test data and expected results for approved changes. Execute system, integration and regression testing; support business users with user acceptance testing and evidence capture. Assess the impact of proposed changes on modules, integrations, reporting, data, security and financial controls. Support release planning, deployment readiness, post-release validation and early-life support. Data, Integrations and Reporting Support finance master data, financial dimensions, posting profiles, workflows, opening balances, sub-ledger data and intercompany processing. Investigate functional issues affecting interfaces with banking, payments, expense, tax, consolidation and reporting platforms. Work with Data and Reporting teams to validate D365 outputs and support reconciliation of reports to the general ledger. Assist with data migration, cleansing, mapping, validation and reconciliation for future deployments and entity onboarding. Controls, Documentation and Governance Follow Finance Systems governance for demand intake, design approval, environments, testing, release and production change. Produce clear and complete evidence for configuration changes, testing, approvals and deployments. Support segregation-of-duties reviews, access-control testing, ITGC evidence and audit requests relating to assigned areas. Escalate control, data-integrity and operational risks promptly to the D365 Functional Lead. Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Transfer Identify opportunities to use standard D365 capability, simplify processes, reduce manual work and improve user experience. Contribute to the prioritised D365 backlog with evidence on business impact, risk, urgency and delivery effort. Provide guidance and knowledge transfer to Finance users and Finance Systems colleagues. Develop broader cross-module capability while maintaining deeper expertise in allocated functional areas. 
 4. Required Skills and Experience 
 Essential 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Dynamics AX functional experience, with substantial exposure to finance modules. Practical configuration experience in at least three core areas such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Expense Management or Project Accounting. Good understanding of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes, including close, reconciliation and financial-control requirements. Experience creating functional requirements, solution documentation, test scripts, test evidence and user guidance. Experience investigating production issues and working with technical teams on integrations, data fixes and extensions. Experience of system, integration, regression and user acceptance testing, together with controlled release and post-deployment validation. Ability to work directly in D365, analyse system behaviour and progress assigned work independently within agreed design and governance standards. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively with Finance users, global colleagues and external delivery partners. Disciplined approach to documentation, knowledge sharing, prioritisation and escalation. Preferred Finance or accounting qualification, or equivalent practical experience in a Finance Systems environment. Experience in financial services, fintech, asset servicing or another regulated, multi-entity environment. Knowledge of IFRS, statutory reporting, segregation of duties and ITGC requirements. Experience with D365 Consolidation, Treasury and Cash Management, Project Accounting, Subscription Billing or Revenue Recognition. Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Workiva, Azure DevOps or finance-data integrations. Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate certification or equivalent evidence of current D365 Finance capability. 
 5. Success Measures 
 Assigned incidents and service requests are investigated thoroughly, documented clearly and resolved or escalated within agreed priorities. Configuration and change deliverables are accurate, supportable and aligned with approved functional designs. Testing is comprehensive, with traceable scenarios, results, defects and evidence. Month-end, year-end and business-critical processing receive reliable functional support. Documentation and knowledge transfer reduce reliance on individual contractors and external partners. Continuous-improvement items deliver measurable operational, control or user-experience benefits. Finance stakeholders and Finance Systems colleagues experience responsive, practical and dependable support. 
 6. Employment Terms and Ways of Working 
 Permanent, full-time appointment into FNZ Technology (India) Private Limited [legal employing entity to be confirmed by HR]. Direct reporting line to the Finance Systems Functional Lead - Finance & Operations and integration into the global Finance Systems team. Standard FNZ India employment terms, benefits, leave, probation and notice provisions apply, subject to HR confirmation. Appointment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, right-to-work verification and any role-specific screening. UK/EU hours overlap is expected for regular collaboration, with flexibility around critical close, release and incident periods. All work must comply with FNZ information-security, data-protection, acceptable-use, change-control and records-management requirements.

 Location: Bengaluru

 Employment Type: Full-time

 About Company: 
 HealthSense is a leading Indian D2C health and wellness brand specializing in the Health, Personal Care and Fitness categories. We offer a wide range of quality products, including smart weighing scales, posture correctors, massagers, medical devices and other wellness essentials. 
 Our products are available across leading Indian e-commerce marketplaces and quick-commerce platforms. We focus on product quality, innovation, reliable warranty support and customer satisfaction. 
 Role Overview: 
 We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented E-commerce Sourcing & Supply Chain Executive with 2–3 years of hands-on experience in domestic and international sourcing, particularly from India and China. The candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and supply chain coordination, including supplier identification, vendor negotiations, purchase orders, shipment tracking, import documentation, customs clearance coordination, inventory planning and timely product delivery. 
 The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of international imports, customs procedures, import duties, freight forwarding and coordination with Customs House Agents (CHAs). Excellent communication and negotiation skills are essential, as the role involves regular coordination with overseas suppliers, logistics partners and internal stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Domestic & International Sourcing Identify, evaluate and onboard reliable suppliers and manufacturers across India and China. Conduct supplier research, market analysis and competitor benchmarking to identify cost-effective sourcing opportunities. Manage supplier communication, quotations, product specifications, samples, MOQ and production timelines. Coordinate product sampling, quality checks and supplier approvals before bulk procurement. Negotiate product pricing, payment terms, credit periods, MOQs and delivery schedules. Develop and maintain strong vendor relationships to ensure consistent product availability and competitive pricing. 2. Import & Customs Clearance Management Coordinate end-to-end import shipments from China to India, working closely with freight forwarders and Customs House Agents (CHAs). Coordinate preparation and verification of import documents, including:
 Commercial Invoice Packing List Bill of Lading (BL) / Air Waybill (AWB) Certificate of Origin (COO), wherever applicable Insurance Certificate Bill of Entry (BOE) Product-specific licences, certificates and regulatory documents, wherever applicable. Coordinate with CHAs for customs documentation, assessment, clearance and shipment release. Understand and coordinate HS Code / HSN classification and verify the applicable customs duty structure for imported products. Have working knowledge of Basic Customs Duty (BCD), Social Welfare Surcharge (SWS), Integrated GST (IGST), Anti-Dumping Duty and other applicable import levies. Follow up on customs queries, document discrepancies, shipment holds and clearance delays. Maintain import records, customs documents and duty-payment details for finance and audit purposes. Monitor detention, demurrage and other avoidable import-related expenses. 3. Freight & Logistics Coordination Coordinate air and sea freight shipments from China and domestic transportation within India. Obtain and compare freight quotations from shipping lines, freight forwarders and logistics partners. Understand basic Incoterms such as EXW, FOB, CIF and DDP and coordinate shipments based on agreed commercial terms. Track shipments from supplier dispatch to warehouse delivery. Coordinate with logistics partners, transporters, forwarders and warehouse teams to ensure timely delivery. Monitor transit timelines, freight costs and shipment-related expenses. 4. Procurement & Vendor Management Prepare and process purchase orders (POs) based on sourcing requirements and inventory plans. Follow up with suppliers on order confirmation, production status, dispatch readiness and delivery schedules. Monitor supplier performance in terms of pricing, quality, lead time and delivery commitments. Maintain vendor databases, quotation records, purchase orders and procurement documentation. Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising product quality. 5. Inventory & Supply Chain Planning Monitor stock levels and coordinate replenishment to prevent stock-outs and overstocking. Coordinate with category, procurement and warehouse teams for SKU-wise inventory planning. Track demand forecasts, stock ageing, reorder levels and supplier lead times. Maintain shipment, inventory and purchase tracking reports. Monitor supply chain KPIs such as OTIF, fill rate, lead time and delivery accuracy. Ensure smooth coordination between sourcing, procurement, warehousing and e-commerce operations. 6. Costing, Reporting & Documentation Prepare product-wise landed cost calculations, including product cost, freight, insurance, customs duties, clearance charges and local transportation. Compare supplier quotations and analyse overall procurement costs. Maintain accurate records of import expenses, customs duties, freight charges and vendor payments. Prepare MIS reports covering sourcing costs, purchase orders, shipment status, inventory and supplier performance. Use MS Excel for cost analysis, vendor comparisons, inventory tracking and reporting.

Working knowledge of import documentation, customs duties, HS Code classification and landed cost calculations. Understanding of international freight, shipping processes and Incoterms. Strong vendor identification, negotiation and relationship management skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to coordinate with international suppliers and multiple stakeholders. Ownership of sourcing and shipment timelines. Analytical thinking and cost-conscious decision-making. title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization. Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment. Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones. Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows. Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews. Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth. Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production). Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up. 
 1. Demand Planning & S&OP Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan. Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering. Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions. Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook. Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework. Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes. Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases. 
 2. Production Planning & Control Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand. Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers. Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders. Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations. Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters. Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput. Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases. 
 3. Material Planning & MRP Existing responsibilities plus: Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan. Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints. Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including: Lead times Lot sizes Safety stocks Reorder levels MOQ Supplier lead times Planning horizons Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts. Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production. Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness. 
 4. Procurement & Supplier Management Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements. Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions. Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness. Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries. Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks. Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required. Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives. Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements. Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components. Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate. 
 5. Inventory Management Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods. Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements. Drive reduction of: Excess inventory Obsolete inventory Slow-moving inventory Uncontrolled WIP Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes. Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity. 
 6. Warehouse & Logistics Existing responsibilities plus: Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations. Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production. Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable. Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials. Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability. Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes. Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site. Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch. 
 Support implementation of traceability systems. Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements. Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions. Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions. Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions. 7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain Existing responsibilities plus: Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems. Establish robust governance for: BOM Material master Routings Lead times Planning parameters Purchase orders Production orders Inventory records Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring. Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation. Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment. Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements. Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live. Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities. Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch. 
 8. Risk Management & Business Continuity Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity. Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions. Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics. Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks. 
 9. Continuous Improvement Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving. Improve: Planning accuracy Inventory turns Supplier OTD Material availability Production plan adherence Lead time OTIF Supply Chain cost Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization. 
 10. Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs. Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases. Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness. Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable. 
 Candidate Profile Education : Bachelor s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering or equivalent. Masters degree / MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Business Administration preferred. Experience 10-15 years of experience in Supply Chain / Operations / Production Planning in a manufacturing environment. Experience in aerospace & defence, electronics, electrical, precision engineering or other high-reliability manufacturing is preferred. Proven experience managing a factory-level supply chain organization. 
 Experience in a greenfield / ramp-up environment would be an advantage Proven experience leading Supply Chain activities in a greenfield manufacturing facility, plant start-up, industrial transfer, major ERP implementation or production ramp-up environment. Demonstrated experience establishing planning, procurement, warehouse and logistics processes from a greenfield or start-up environment. Demonstrated success in achieving production readiness, launch readiness and operational stabilization during plant ramp-up. Technical Competencies Existing competencies plus: S&OP / IBP MPS / MRP Production Planning & Control Material Planning Procurement Inventory Management Warehouse Management Supplier Management Capacity Planning ERP / MRP / PLM systems Advanced Excel / Power BI or equivalent analytics tools Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma Greenfield Plant Launch & Start-Up Industrialization & Manufacturing Ramp-Up Project Management Program Management Change Management ERP Deployment & Go-Live Master Data Governance Launch Readiness & Operational Readiness Reviews New Product Introduction (NPI) 
 Leadership Competencies Existing competencies plus: Strong analytical and problem-solving capability Ability to manage cross-functional teams Strong stakeholder-management skills Ability to operate in a high growth / high-pressure manufacturing environment Strong execution discipline Data-driven decision making Excellent communication and escalation management Ability to build and develop Supply Chain teams Proven ability to build Supply Chain organizations, processes and governance from the ground up. Experience recruiting, developing and scaling Supply Chain teams during periods of rapid growth. Strong project leadership and cross-functional execution capabilities. Ability to lead through uncertainty, ambiguity and changing business priorities typical of greenfield environments. 
 Strong capability to balance launch objectives with operational performance requirements.

title: Manager / Senior Manager -Supply Chain Management (SCM)
description:
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Manager / Senior Manager Supply Chain Management to manage end-to-end supply chain operations for our fertilizer business. The candidate will be responsible for demand planning, procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, logistics, vendor management, and cost optimization. The role requires strong coordination with Production, Quality, Finance, and Commercial teams to ensure smooth plant operations, timely material availability, and efficient product distribution. Key Responsibilities 1. Supply Chain Strategy & Planning Lead demand planning, Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), and Material Requirements Planning (MRP). Prepare monthly rolling forecasts and ensure alignment between production plans and sales requirements. Develop supply chain strategies for raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Optimize inventory levels and ensure uninterrupted supply to manufacturing operations. 2. Procurement & Vendor Management Manage procurement of raw materials such as urea, complex fertilizers, additives, and packaging materials. Identify and develop suppliers, negotiate contracts, and manage vendor relationships. Conduct supplier performance reviews, RFQs, cost negotiations, and vendor assessments. Develop alternate sourcing strategies to minimize supply risks. 3. Production Planning & Coordination Coordinate with production teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials. Prepare material requisitions and prioritize critical procurement requirements. Monitor work-in-progress (WIP), material consumption, yield variations, and product changeovers. Ensure smooth coordination between production and supply chain functions. 4. Warehouse & Inventory Management Manage warehouse operations and inventory across manufacturing plants and distribution locations. Implement FIFO practices, batch traceability, stock audits, and regular cycle counts. Maintain inventory accuracy and coordinate stock reconciliation with Finance. Ensure proper storage conditions to prevent moisture ingress, product contamination, and material damage. 5. Logistics & Distribution Management Manage inbound and outbound logistics, dispatch planning, and transportation operations. Handle third-party logistics (3PL) partners, transport routing, and freight negotiations. Optimize freight costs and ensure timely product deliveries. Monitor shipping documentation, GRNs, delivery challans, and ERP updates. 6. Regulatory Compliance & Safety Ensure compliance with Fertilizer Control Order (FCO), fertilizer handling regulations, and applicable safety standards. Maintain MSDS documentation, proper labeling, storage, and emergency handling procedures. Ensure safe transportation and handling of raw materials and finished products. 7. Cost Optimization & Performance Management Drive working capital optimization and reduce inventory holding costs. Monitor inventory turnover, logistics costs, procurement savings, and stock availability. Track KPIs such as OTIF, inventory accuracy, freight cost per ton, and stockout incidents. Prepare MIS reports and present supply chain performance to senior management. 8. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead and manage procurement, warehouse, dispatch, and logistics teams. Coordinate with Production, Quality, Finance, and Commercial departments. Establish SOPs, operational processes, and performance standards. Develop team capabilities and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a relevant field. MBA preferred. 8 - 12+ years of experience in Supply Chain Management, with at least 3 - 5 years in a leadership role. Candidates from Fertilizer, Chemical, or Manufacturing industries will be preferred. Strong experience in procurement, demand planning, inventory control, warehouse management, and logistics. Hands-on experience in S&OP, MRP, FIFO, and 3PL management. Knowledge of ERP systems, advanced MS Excel, and data analysis tools. Strong vendor negotiation, supplier development, and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of FCO, fertilizer handling regulations, and industrial safety standards. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and leadership abilities. Willingness to work onsite at Roha / Pune and travel occasionally to vendors and distribution hubs.

title: Senior Manager - Company Secretary
description:
Senior Manager - Company Secretary (CS) Company: Yes Capital Group
 Location: Gurugram
 Experience: 2 - 8 Years
 Qualification: Qualified Company Secretary (CS)
 About the Role We are looking for an experienced and qualified Company Secretary to lead secretarial, corporate governance, and regulatory compliance functions for our NBFC operations. The candidate should have strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, SEBI regulations (where applicable), and RBI guidelines and regulations governing NBFCs. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Corporate Secretarial & Governance Ensure end-to-end compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable rules and regulations. Organise and coordinate Board Meetings, Committee Meetings, and General Meetings, including preparation of agendas, notices, minutes, and related documentation. Handle statutory filings with MCA/ROC, including annual returns and event-based compliances. Maintain statutory registers, records, and other secretarial documentation. Ensure compliance with corporate governance requirements and applicable regulatory guidelines. 
 2. RBI & NBFC Regulatory Compliance Ensure adherence to RBI regulations, circulars, directions, and guidelines applicable to NBFCs. Monitor and implement regulatory updates issued by RBI and ensure timely compliance. Handle RBI-related regulatory filings, returns, and submissions within prescribed timelines. Ensure compliance with applicable NBFC Scale Based Regulation (SBR) framework. Monitor compliance with KYC/AML guidelines, Fair Practices Code, outsourcing guidelines, and other applicable RBI directions. Coordinate RBI inspections, regulatory audits, and supervisory requirements. Maintain regulatory compliance trackers and ensure timely closure of observations and action points. Liaise with RBI and other regulatory authorities wherever required. 
 3. Legal & Regulatory Coordination Coordinate with internal and external legal counsel on corporate and regulatory matters. Review agreements, resolutions, declarations, and other corporate documents from a compliance perspective. Support management in assessing regulatory implications of business decisions and proposed transactions. Ensure timely implementation of regulatory changes across applicable business functions. 
 4. Compliance Monitoring & Reporting Develop and maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar and regulatory tracker. Conduct periodic compliance reviews and identify potential gaps or areas of non-compliance. Prepare compliance reports and present updates to senior management and the Board. Coordinate internal, statutory, and secretarial audits and ensure timely resolution of audit observations. 
 Desired Candidate Profile Qualified Company Secretary (CS) with 58 years of relevant post-qualification experience. Prior experience in an NBFC, HFC, or financial services organisation is preferred. Strong hands-on experience in RBI compliance and NBFC regulatory requirements is essential. Thorough knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013, MCA/ROC filings, and corporate governance. Good understanding of RBI's NBFC Scale Based Regulation framework and applicable master directions. Experience in handling Board and Committee Meetings, statutory filings, RBI returns, and regulatory audits. Strong drafting, interpretation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to independently manage secretarial and regulatory compliance functions. 
 Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.

Key Skills: NBFC,RBI Reporting,Secretarial Compliance,Senior management,Auditing,RBI,Compliance,Audit compliance

title: Senior Procurement Executive
description:
Senior Executive Procurement 
 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 3 to 6 years Languages Required: English, Native language & Hindi (fluent) Education: Bachelor's in Business/Agribusiness/Food Technology/Commerce/SCM or related field 
 Why This Role Exists 
We depend on getting the right raw materials, at the right price, without compromising on quality. Good procurement isn't just about negotiating the lowest price - it's about protecting quality standards while doing it, so the group gets consistent, reliable supply it can build every product on. This role owns that balance - sourcing competitively while never trading away quality. 
 What You'll Be Doing Identify, evaluate and develop reliable suppliers across group companies requirements, with backup suppliers to secure continuity. Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and lead negotiations on price, payment terms, MOQ and delivery - balancing cost savings with strict quality standards. Track market prices, seasonal trends, crop cycles and supply risk and flag significant shifts to Management. Coordinate with Quality Control to ensure materials meet required specifications, and drive resolution on rejected or non-conforming materials. Own purchase orders end-to-end from supplier confirmation through final delivery - including coordination with Logistics. Drive cost optimization and process improvement, without compromising quality or supply reliability. Coordinate with Sales/BD, Quality, Logistics, Accounts and Management across group companies to align procurement with business needs. Maintain accurate procurement records and prepare reports on pricing, deliveries, quality issues and cost savings. 
 What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Agribusiness, Food Technology, Commerce, Supply Chain Management or a related field. 3 to 6 years of experience in Procurement, Purchase, Sourcing, Supply Chain or Vendor Management. Experience in FMCG, food products, agricultural commodities, spices or dehydrated vegetables highly preferred. Strong negotiation and vendor management skills with an eye for quality, not just price. Good working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets, ERP or procurement software exposure is a plus. Fluent in English, Tamil and Hindi, with strong stakeholder-management ability. Willing to travel to supplier markets and sourcing locations and across group company sites if needed.

title: Purchase Executive
description:
Job Description Purchase Executive Position: Purchase Executive Engineering Spare Parts
 Department: Purchase / Procurement
 Experience: 510 Years
 Qualification: Bcom/ B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Electrical or related Engineering field 
 Job Summary:- 
 We are looking for an experienced Purchase Executive with strong technical knowledge and expertise in the procurement of engineering spare parts, mechanical components, industrial equipment and maintenance-related materials . The candidate will be responsible for sourcing, vendor development, negotiation, purchase planning and ensuring timely availability of quality materials at competitive prices. 
 Key Responsibilities:- 
 Handle end-to-end procurement of engineering spare parts, mechanical and industrial components . Identify and source reliable suppliers for engineering and maintenance requirements. Understand technical specifications, drawings, BOMs and engineering requirements before initiating procurement. Procure items such as bearings, gears, shafts, couplings, seals, fasteners, valves, pumps, motors, electrical components, pneumatic/hydraulic parts and other industrial spares . Source OEM, equivalent and alternative components based on technical requirements and availability. Prepare and send RFQs to suppliers and obtain competitive quotations. Compare quotations based on price, quality, technical specifications, delivery period and payment terms . Negotiate with suppliers for the best price, quality, credit terms and delivery schedules . Develop and maintain a strong network of approved vendors, OEMs and local suppliers . Coordinate with the Engineering, Maintenance, Production, Stores and Accounts teams to understand material requirements. Ensure timely placement of purchase orders and follow up with suppliers until material delivery. Monitor pending orders and ensure on-time delivery of critical engineering spare parts. Evaluate and develop new vendors based on quality, capability, pricing and delivery performance . Maintain proper records of purchase orders, quotations, vendor details and procurement documentation . Handle urgent and breakdown-related procurement requirements on priority. Verify received materials against purchase orders, specifications and required quality standards in coordination with the concerned departments. Identify opportunities for cost reduction, alternate sourcing and inventory optimization . Maintain appropriate stock levels for critical and frequently used engineering spare parts . Resolve supplier-related issues concerning quality, quantity, specifications and delivery delays . Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and approved purchasing procedures. Prepare regular MIS and procurement reports related to purchases, savings, pending orders and vendor performance. Required Skills Strong technical understanding of engineering spare parts and industrial components . Hands-on experience in procurement/purchasing of engineering and maintenance spares . Ability to read and understand engineering drawings, technical specifications and BOMs . Strong vendor development and negotiation skills . Good knowledge of local and industrial supplier markets. Strong follow-up, coordination and analytical skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel and ERP/Purchase Management systems . Ability to handle multiple purchase requirements and urgent procurement independently. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Engineering / Bcom qualification with relevant experience in Purchase/Procurement . Proven experience in sourcing engineering spare parts and industrial components . Candidates with experience in manufacturing, engineering, industrial equipment or maintenance procurement will be preferred. Should have strong knowledge of vendor identification, technical evaluation, price negotiation and cost-effective sourcing .

Maintain accurate service records, documentation, and system updates, ensuring data integrity and providing visibility into service performance. Track key service metrics and generate reports to support operational reviews, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous process optimization. Support business objectives by ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and quality requirements while contributing to a culture of operational excellence and teamwork. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of ~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. description:

Strong knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP), including experience with language models (GPT-3, BERT), intent recognition, entity extraction, and semantic parsing. Expertise in Machine Learning (ML) techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, reinforcement learning, and active learning. Experience with document parsing technologies to extract structured data from unstructured resume text. Proficiency with AI and ML frameworks and tools like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, spaCy, etc. Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) for deploying AI models and building scalable solutions. Understanding of Reinforcement Learning (RL) for dialogue systems to improve agent behavior over time. Experience with voice-enabled conversational bots. Part time/work from home/freelancer required.

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
Department - Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Location - Bengaluru, Karnataka Reports To - CEO Experience - Minimum 5 years, with at least 3 years in a CRM, customer experience, or dealer-relations leadership role Qualification - Bachelors degree in marketing, Business Administration, Information Technology, or Preferred: MBA in a related field 
 About KisanKraft 
 KisanKraft Limited is a Bengaluru-headquartered agricultural equipment and power tools company, serving farmers across India through a dealer network of 5,000+ and exporting to 16+ countries worldwide. Our 46-acre manufacturing facility in Nellore anchors a business built on reliability, innovation, and farmer-first thinking. As we scale our reach and deepen our farmer and dealer relationships, we are looking for a CRM Manager to lead the systems, processes, and people that keep our customers and channel partners at the center of everything we do. 
 Role Summary 
 The CRM Manager owns the development, execution, and continuous refinement of KisanKraft's multi-channel Customer and Dealer Relationship Management function from lead management and complaint resolution to loyalty, retention, and dealer-engagement programs. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role that requires strong project management, process discipline, data fluency, and the ability to work closely with Sales, IT, Branding, and Product teams to ensure every farmer and dealer interaction reflects KisanKraft's standards of trust and service. You will need to set an example to other members of the CRM team. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Customer & Dealer Relationship Management 
 Own the end-to-end enquiry pipeline generated from website, calls, emails, social media, print, IndiaMART, exhibitions, and other sources — connecting with leads accurately and promptly. Afterwards routing the potential leads to the relevant sales team across India or to e-commerce purchase. Manage resolution of customer and dealer complaints by coordinating with the relevant service and sales personnel and tracking cases through to closure. Maintain and continuously update dealer master data and sales-team employee data, ensuring accuracy across all CRM and reporting systems. Continuous customer engagement through seasonal greetings, dealer offers/discount communications, social media leads follow-up, and other company announcements to dealers and employees through appropriate channels. 
 2. Sales Enablement & Lead Conversion Perform the first-level screening of incoming enquiries/leads to assess genuineness and purchase potential before routing them to the relevant sales team. Support the sales team in converting enquiries to closed sales through structured daily follow-ups, reminders, and lead-nurturing cadences. Track lead-to-conversion funnel performance and flag drop-off points to Sales leadership for corrective action. Drive initiatives to increase e-commerce purchase conversion and repeat online orders from dealers and customers. Manage paid communication and campaigns to dealers and customers for promotions, product updates, and service alerts. 
 3. CRM Systems, Data & Analytics Analyze CRM team performance and productivity — enquiry volumes, response times, resolution rates, conversion rates — and maintain an up-to-date performance tracker/dashboard. Work with the Branding and IT teams to keep e-commerce lead and customer data clean and accurate. Own implementation and ongoing maintenance of CRM-related IT projects, including periodic upgrades and issue resolution. Coordinate with IT teams to update and design inhouse CRM system. 
 4. Training & Content Development Create and maintain user manuals for KisanKraft products, keeping content current as the product portfolio evolves. Develop training content on agricultural products and power tools. Localize training and customer-facing content into regional and other country languages to serve KisanKraft's pan-India and global dealer and farmer base. 
 5. Branding & Marketing Support Provide coordinated support to the Branding, Marketing and Sales team on farmer events, exhibitions, and campaigns to improve customer engagement. 
 What We're Looking For Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple CRM workstreams simultaneously. Comfort with CRM tools, dealer/customer databases, and basic data analysis; exposure to web/app analytics is a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; multilingual ability (including regional Indian languages, Hindi, and English) is a strong advantage. A process-oriented, farmer- and dealer-first mindset, with the ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, IT, Branding, and zonal teams. Prior experience in agri-equipment, industrial products, FMCG, or a dealer/distributor-led business is preferred. 
 Travel Occasional travel is required to visit exhibitions, dealers, customers, farmer events, and branches across India.

Key Skills: Content development,Leadership,Data,Sales Enablement,Relationship management,Management,System,Sales

title: Manager - Pricing - Freight Forwarding
description:
Ocean Export Pricing & Booking Management
- Develop and execute booking strategies aligned with volume, capacity, customer and profitability objectives. 
- Ensure clear visibility of bookings, carrier allocation, capacity utilization and pricing commitments. 
- Optimize carrier mix with focus on core carriers including Hapag-Lloyd, CMA CGM, MSC, COSCO and Maersk. 
- Maintain spot business within defined thresholds and drive greater utilization of core carrier contracts. 
- Monitor booking performance and proactively address capacity, rate and allocation gaps. 
- Ensure timely and accurate updation of pricing, booking and performance trackers. 
Carrier & Rate Management
- Manage commercial relationships with shipping lines and support negotiation of competitive ocean freight rates. 
- Track market movements, carrier rate changes, GRIs/PSS and other relevant pricing developments. 
- Provide regular market intelligence and pricing updates to Sales and network offices. 
- Identify opportunities to optimize carrier selection and improve overall buying efficiency. 
- Ensure pricing decisions balance competitiveness, volume growth and profitability. 
Sales & Commercial Support
- Partner with Sales, network offices and sector teams to support new business acquisition and existing account growth. 
- Develop pricing strategies for own accounts, new opportunities and special products. 
- Support sales promotions across network offices, sectors and target customer segments. 
- Provide timely and competitive quotations to improve business conversion. 
- Maintain accurate quote logs and track business wins, losses and conversion trends. 
Trade Lane Development
- Identify opportunities to develop and expand priority ocean export trade lanes. 
- Analyse market trends, customer demand, carrier capacity and competitive pricing to identify growth opportunities. 
- Develop strategies for new and special products and support their commercial penetration. 
- Drive year-on-year growth across identified target trade lanes. 
Volume & Profitability Management
- Drive FCL volume growth through effective pricing, carrier strategy and commercial support. 
- Monitor contribution and EBITA performance across trade lanes, customers and carrier portfolios. 
- Identify opportunities to improve yields, reduce cost leakage and enhance profitability. 
- Work with Sales and Operations to improve conversion and profitable volume acquisition. 
Performance & MIS Management
- Maintain accurate and timely monthly pricing and performance sheets. 
- Ensure regular updates of quote logs, booking trackers, carrier allocation and market intelligence. 
- Monitor business win percentage, FCL volumes, carrier mix and profitability against targets. 
- Prepare periodic performance analysis and highlight key trends, gaps and corrective actions to management. 
Branch & Product Maturity
- Work with target branches to improve ocean export pricing capability and product maturity. 
- Provide guidance to branches on market rates, carrier strategies, trade lanes and pricing practices. 
- Drive adoption of standard pricing processes and commercial best practices across eligible branches. 
- Support branches in improving pricing discipline, customer conversion and profitable volume growth.

title: Sr Service Support Coordinator
description:
Join a dynamic and customer-focused service organization where you will play a critical role in ensuring seamless coordination of field service activities and delivering an exceptional customer experience. As a Service Coordinator, you will work closely with customers, field engineers, and cross-functional teams to manage service operations, drive efficiency, and support the successful execution of service commitments. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your organizational skills, problem-solving mindset, and ability to build strong relationships will directly contribute to customer success and operational excellence. Responsibilities Monitor service orders from initiation through completion, proactively identifying and resolving scheduling, logistics, or operational issues to minimize delays and improve service performance. Collaborate with field engineers, service managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure efficient execution of service commitments and adherence to operational processes. Maintain accurate service records, documentation, and system updates, ensuring data integrity and providing visibility into service performance. Track key service metrics and generate reports to support operational reviews, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous process optimization. Support business objectives by ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and quality requirements while contributing to a culture of operational excellence and teamwork. Qualifications Bachelor s degree with 3-5+ years of experience in service coordination, field service operations, customer support, scheduling or a related operational role within a service-driven organization.
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple service requests, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with customers, field service engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Proficiency in ERP, CRM, and service management systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceMax, or similar tools), along with strong Microsoft Office skills.
Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a proactive approach to resolving scheduling, logistics, and customer service challenges.
Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail, data accuracy, teamwork, and a commitment to delivering high-quality service and operational excellence. Company Description Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of ~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. Company Name : NewAgeSys IT, (a division of NewAgeSys)
Location : Carnival Infopark, Phase 2 , Kakkanad, Ernakulam

NewAgeSysIT , a division of NewAgeSys, Inc. established in 1994, based at New Jersey, specializes in mobile app development and consulting, helping clients maximize the reach and effectiveness of their business by leveraging the latest technology. Being a full service mobile and web development firm, NewAgeSMB focuses on servicing clients across North America, UK, Europe, Middle East, Singapore and Australia. We accomplish this by creating a long-term relationship with our clients, from brainstorming the initial idea, strategizing the project plan, building and deploying cost effective solutions with a solid foundation of support and maintenance. Role Overview 
We are looking for an experienced Content Editor to review and refine our business, technical, and marketing content. The role also includes evaluating supporting visuals for relevance and communication effectiveness. Key Responsibilities

Content Types Covered
Website pages, landing pages, and blog articles

Case studies, white papers, and industry reports
